sections.label: A glorification of the Asvins' Whip and a prayer for blessings
sections.name: Book 9, hymn 1

verses.sa:
दिवस्पृथिव्या अन्तरिक्षात् समुद्रादग्नेर्वातान्मधुकशा हि जज्ञे।
तां चायित्वामृतं वसानां हृद्भिः प्रजाः प्रति नन्दन्ति सर्वाः॥
verses.tr: divaspṛthivyā antarikṣāt samudrādagnervātānmadhukaśā hi jajñe tāṃ cāyitvāmṛtaṃ vasānāṃ hṛdbhiḥ prajāḥ prati nandanti sarvāḥ
verses.en: The Asvins Honey-whip was born from heaven and earth, from middle air, and ocean, and from fire and wind. All living creatures welcome it with joyful hearts, fraught with the store of Amrit it hath gathered up.

verses.sa:
महत् पयो विश्वरूपमस्याः समुद्रस्य त्वोत रेत आहुः ।
यत ऐति मधुकशा रराणा तत् प्राणस्तदमृतं निविष्टम्॥
verses.tr: mahat payo viśvarūpamasyāḥ samudrasya tvota reta āhuḥ yata aiti madhukaśā rarāṇā tat prāṇastadamṛtaṃ niviṣṭam
verses.en: They call thee earth's great strength in every form, they call thee too the ocean's genial seed. Whence comes the Honey-whip bestowing bounty, there Vital Spirit is, and Amrit treasured.

verses.sa:
पश्यन्त्यस्याश्चरितं पृथिव्यां पृथङ् नरो बहुधा मीमांसमानाः ।
अग्नेर्वातान्मधुकशा हि जज्ञे मरुतामुग्रा नप्तिः॥
verses.tr: paśyantyasyāścaritaṃ pṛthivyāṃ pṛthaṅ naro bahudhā mīmāṃsamānāḥ agnervātānmadhukaśā hi jajñe marutāmugrā naptiḥ
verses.en: In sundry spots, repeatedly reflecting, men view upon the earth her course and action; For she, the first-born daughter of the Maruts, derives her origin from Wind and Agni, fs

verses.sa:
मातादित्यानां दुहिता वसूनां प्राणः प्रजानाममृतस्य नाभिः ।
हिरण्यवर्णा मधुकशा घृताची महान् गर्भश्चरति मर्त्येषु॥
verses.tr: mātādityānāṃ duhitā vasūnāṃ prāṇaḥ prajānāmamṛtasya nābhiḥ hiraṇyavarṇā madhukaśā ghṛtācī mahān garbhaścarati martyeṣu
verses.en: Daughter of Vasus, mother of Adityas, centre of Amrit, breath of living creatures, The Honey-whip, gold-coloured, dropping fatness, moves as a mighty embryo 'mid mortals.

verses.sa:
मधोः कशामजनयन्त देवास्तस्या गर्भो अभवद् विश्वरूपः ।
तं जातं तरुणं पिपर्ति माता स जातो विश्वा भुवना वि चष्टे॥
verses.tr: madhoḥ kaśāmajanayanta devāstasyā garbho abhavad viśvarūpaḥ taṃ jātaṃ taruṇaṃ piparti mātā sa jāto viśvā bhuvanā vi caṣṭe
verses.en: The deities begat the Whip of Honey: her embryo assumed all forms and fashions. The mother nourishes that tender infant which at its birth looks on all worlds and beings.

verses.sa:
कस्तं प्र वेद क उ तं चिकेत यो अस्या हृदः कलशः सोमधानो अक्षितः ।
ब्रह्मा सुमेधाः सो अस्मिन् मदेत॥
verses.tr: kastaṃ pra veda ka u taṃ ciketa yo asyā hṛdaḥ kalaśaḥ somadhāno akṣitaḥ brahmā sumedhāḥ so asmin madeta
verses.en: Who understandeth well, who hath perceived it, her heart's uninjured Soma-holding beaker? Let the wise Brahman priest therein be joyful.

verses.sa:
स तौ प्र वेद स उ तौ चिकेत यावस्याः स्तनौ सहस्रधारावक्षितौ ।
ऊर्जं दुहाते अनपस्फुरन्तौ॥
verses.tr: sa tau pra veda sa u tau ciketa yāvasyāḥ stanau sahasradhārāvakṣitau ūrjaṃ duhāte anapasphurantau
verses.en: He understandeth them, he hath perceived them, her breasts that pour a thousand streams, uninjured: They unreluctantly yield strength and vigour.

verses.sa:
हिङ्करिक्रती बृहती वयोधा उच्चैर्घोषाभ्येति या व्रतम्।
त्रीन् घर्मानभि वावशाना मिमाति मायुं पयते पयोभिः॥
verses.tr: hiṅkarikratī bṛhatī vayodhā uccairghoṣābhyeti yā vratam trīn gharmānabhi vāvaśānā mimāti māyuṃ payate payobhiḥ
verses.en: She who with voice upraised in constant clamour, mighty, life-giving, goes unto her function, Bellowing to the heated three libations, suckles with streams of milk, and still is lowing.

verses.sa:
यामापीनामुपसीदन्त्यापः शाक्वरा वृषभा ये स्वराजः ।
ते वर्षन्ति ते वर्षयन्ति तद्विदे काममूर्जमापः॥
verses.tr: yāmāpīnāmupasīdantyāpaḥ śākvarā vṛṣabhā ye svarājaḥ te varṣanti te varṣayanti tadvide kāmamūrjamāpaḥ
verses.en: On whom, well-fed, the Waters wait in worship, and steers and self-refulgent bulls attend her. For thee, for one like thee down pour the Waters, and cause desire and strength to rain upon thee.-

verses.sa:
स्तनयित्नुस्ते वाक् प्रजापते वृषा शुष्मं क्षिपसि भूम्यामधि ।
अग्नेर्वातान्मधुकशा हि जज्ञे मरुतामुग्रा नप्तिः॥
verses.tr: stanayitnuste vāk prajāpate vṛṣā śuṣmaṃ kṣipasi bhūmyāmadhi agnervātānmadhukaśā hi jajñe marutāmugrā naptiḥ
verses.en: The thunder is thy voice, O Lord of Creatures: a Bull, thou castest on the earth thy vigour. The Honey-whip, the Maruts' first-born a a derives her origin from Wind and Agni.

verses.sa:
यथा सोमः प्रातःसवने अश्विनोर्भवति प्रियः ।
एवा मे अश्विना वर्च आत्मनि ध्रियताम्॥
verses.tr: yathā somaḥ prātaḥsavane aśvinorbhavati priyaḥ evā me aśvinā varca ātmani dhriyatām
verses.en: As at the morning sacrifice the Asvins twain love Soma well, Even so may both the Asvins lay splendour and strength within my soul.

verses.sa:
यथा सोमो द्वितीये सवन इन्द्राग्न्योर्भवति प्रियः ।
एवा म इन्द्राग्नी वर्च आत्मनि ध्रियताम्॥
verses.tr: yathā somo dvitīye savana indrāgnyorbhavati priyaḥ evā ma indrāgnī varca ātmani dhriyatām
verses.en: As at the second sacrifice Indra and Agni love him well, Let the pair, Indra Agni, lay splendour and strength within my soul.

verses.sa:
यथा सोमस्तृतीये सवन ऋभूणां भवति प्रियः ।
एवा म ऋभवो वर्च आत्मनि ध्रियताम्॥
verses.tr: yathā somastṛtīye savana ṛbhūṇāṃ bhavati priyaḥ evā ma ṛbhavo varca ātmani dhriyatām
verses.en: As at third sacrifice Soma is the Ribhus' well-beloved one, Even so may they, the Ribhus, store splendour and strength within my soul.

verses.sa:
मधु जनिषीय मधु वंसिषीय ।
पयस्वानग्न आगमं तं मा सं सृज वर्चसा॥
verses.tr: madhu janiṣīya madhu vaṃsiṣīya payasvānagna āgamaṃ taṃ mā saṃ sṛja varcasā
verses.en: Fain would I bring forth sweetness, fain would make it mine. Bringing milk, Agni! have I come: splendour and strength bestow on me!

verses.sa:
सं माग्ने वर्चसा सृज सं प्रजया समायुषा ।
विद्युर्मे अस्य देवा इन्द्रो विद्यात् सह ऋषिभिः॥
verses.tr: saṃ māgne varcasā sṛja saṃ prajayā samāyuṣā vidyurme asya devā indro vidyāt saha ṛṣibhiḥ
verses.en: Grant me, O Agni, splendid strength, and progeny, and lengthened life. May the Gods know me as I am, may Indra with the Rishis know.

verses.sa:
यथा मधु मधुकृतः संभरन्ति मधावधि ।
एवा मे अश्विना वर्च आत्मनि ध्रियताम्॥
verses.tr: yathā madhu madhukṛtaḥ saṃbharanti madhāvadhi evā me aśvinā varca ātmani dhriyatām
verses.en: As honey-bees collect and add fresh honey to their honey store, Even so may both the Asvins lay splendour and strength within my soul.

verses.sa:
यथा मक्षाः इदं मधु न्यञ्जन्ति मधावधि ।
एवा मे अश्विना वर्चस्तेजो बलमोजश्च ध्रियताम्॥
verses.tr: yathā makṣāḥ idaṃ madhu nyañjanti madhāvadhi evā me aśvinā varcastejo balamojaśca dhriyatām
verses.en: As over honey flies besmear this honey which the bees have made, So may both Asvins lay in me splendour and strength and power and might.

verses.sa:
यद् गिरिषु पर्वतेषु गोष्वश्वेषु यन्मधु ।
सुरायां सिच्यमानायां यत् तत्र मधु तन्मयि॥
verses.tr: yad giriṣu parvateṣu goṣvaśveṣu yanmadhu surāyāṃ sicyamānāyāṃ yat tatra madhu tanmayi
verses.en: May all the sweetness that is found in hills and mountains, steeds and kine, And wine that floweth from the cup.—may all that sweetness be in me.

verses.sa:
अश्विना सारघेण मा मधुनाङ्क्तं शुभस्पती ।
यथा वर्चस्वतीं वाचमावदानि जनाँ अनु॥
verses.tr: aśvinā sāragheṇa mā madhunāṅktaṃ śubhaspatī yathā varcasvatīṃ vācamāvadāni janāṃ anu
verses.en: May both the Asvins, Lords of Light, balm me with honey of the bees, That I may speak among the folk words full of splendour and of strength.

verses.sa:
स्तनयित्नुस्ते वाक् प्रजापते वृषा शुष्मं क्षिपसि भूम्यां दिवि।
तां पशव उप जीवन्ति सर्वे तेनो सेषमूर्जं पिपर्ति॥
verses.tr: stanayitnuste vāk prajāpate vṛṣā śuṣmaṃ kṣipasi bhūmyāṃ divi tāṃ paśava upa jīvanti sarve teno seṣamūrjaṃ piparti
verses.en: The thunder is thy voice, O Lord of Creatures: a Bull, thou castest strength on earth and heaven. To that all cattle look for their existence: with this she nourishes their force and vigour.

verses.sa: पृथिवी दण्डो३न्तरिक्षं गर्भो द्यौः कशा विद्युत् प्रकशो हिरण्ययो बिन्दुः॥
verses.tr: pṛthivī daṇḍo3ntarikṣaṃ garbho dyauḥ kaśā vidyut prakaśo hiraṇyayo binduḥ
verses.en: The Whip itself is Heaven, Earth is the handle, the point of juncture is the Air's mid-region. The lash is lightning; and the tip is golden,

verses.sa:
यो वै कशायाः सप्त मधूनि वेद मधुमान् भवति ।
ब्राह्मणश्च राजा च धेनुश्चानड्वांश्च व्रीहिश्च यवश्च मधु सप्तमम्॥
verses.tr: yo vai kaśāyāḥ sapta madhūni veda madhumān bhavati brāhmaṇaśca rājā ca dhenuścānaḍvāṃśca vrīhiśca yavaśca madhu saptamam
verses.en: Whoever knows the Whip's seven kinds of honey, becomes himself a man endowed with sweetness. Brahman and King, the draught-ox and the milch-cow, barley and rice, and honey is the seventh.

verses.sa:
मधुमान् भवति मधुमदस्याहार्यंऽ भवति ।
मधुमतो लोकान् जयति य एवं वेद॥
verses.tr: madhumān bhavati madhumadasyāhāryaṃ' bhavati madhumato lokān jayati ya evaṃ veda
verses.en: Sweet is the man, sweet are his goods and chattels: he who knows this conquers the worlds of sweetness.

verses.sa:
यद् वीध्रे स्तनयति प्रजापतिरेव तत् प्रजाभ्यः प्रादुर्भवति ।
तस्मात् प्राचीनोपवीतस्तिष्ठे प्रजापतेऽनु मा बुध्यस्वेति ।
अन्वेनं प्रजा अनु प्रजापतिर्बुध्यते य एवं वेद॥
verses.tr: yad vīdhre stanayati prajāpatireva tat prajābhyaḥ prādurbhavati tasmāt prācīnopavītastiṣṭhe prajāpate'nu mā budhyasveti anvenaṃ prajā anu prajāpatirbudhyate ya evaṃ veda
verses.en: The thundering of Prajapati in heaven is verily manifest to living creatures. Therefore I stand from right to left invested, and, O Prajapati, I cry, regard me! The man who hath this knowledge is regarded by living beings and the Lord of Creatures.

sections.label: A glorification of Kama as God of desire of all that is good
sections.name: Book 9, hymn 2

verses.sa:
सपत्नहनमृषभं घृतेन कामं शिक्षामि हविषाज्येन ।
नीचैः सपत्नान् मम पादय त्वमभिष्टुतो महता वीर्येऽण॥
verses.tr: sapatnahanamṛṣabhaṃ ghṛtena kāmaṃ śikṣāmi haviṣājyena nīcaiḥ sapatnān mama pādaya tvamabhiṣṭuto mahatā vīrye'ṇa
verses.en: Kama the Bull, slayer of foes, I worship with molten butter, sacrifice, oblation. Beneath my feet cast down mine adversaries, with. thy great manly power, when I have praised thee.

verses.sa:
यन्मे मनसो न प्रियं चक्षुषो यन्मे बभस्ति नाभिनन्दति ।
तद् दुष्वप्न्यं प्रति मुञ्चामि सपत्ने कामं स्तुत्वोदहं भिदेयम्॥
verses.tr: yanme manaso na priyaṃ cakṣuṣo yanme babhasti nābhinandati tad duṣvapnyaṃ prati muñcāmi sapatne kāmaṃ stutvodahaṃ bhideyam
verses.en: That which is hateful to mine eye and spirit, that harasses and robs me of enjoyment, The evil dream I loose upon my foemen. May I rend him when I have lauded Kama.

verses.sa:
दुष्वप्न्यं काम दुरितं च कामाप्रजस्तामस्वगतामवर्तिम्।
उग्र ईशानः प्रति मुञ्च तस्मिन् यो अस्मभ्यमंहूरणा चिकित्सात्॥
verses.tr: duṣvapnyaṃ kāma duritaṃ ca kāmāprajastāmasvagatāmavartim ugra īśānaḥ prati muñca tasmin yo asmabhyamaṃhūraṇā cikitsāt
verses.en: Kama, do thou, a mighty Lord and Ruler, let loose ill dream, misfortune, want of children, Homelessness, Kama! utter destitution, upon the sinner who designs my ruin.

verses.sa:
नुदस्व काम प्र णुदस्व कामावर्तिं यन्तु मम ये सपत्नाः ।
तेषां नुत्तानामधमा तमांस्यग्ने वास्तूनि निर्दह त्वम्॥
verses.tr: nudasva kāma pra ṇudasva kāmāvartiṃ yantu mama ye sapatnāḥ teṣāṃ nuttānāmadhamā tamāṃsyagne vāstūni nirdaha tvam
verses.en: Drive them away, drive them afar, O Kama; indigence fall on those who are my foemen! When they have been cast down to deepest darkness, consume their dwellings with thy fire, O Agni.

verses.sa:
सा ते काम दुहिता धेनुरुच्यते यामाहुर्वाचं कवयो विराजम्।
तया सपत्नान् परि वृङ्ग्धि ये मम पर्येनान् प्राणः पशवो जीवनं वृणक्तु॥
verses.tr: sā te kāma duhitā dhenurucyate yāmāhurvācaṃ kavayo virājam tayā sapatnān pari vṛṅgdhi ye mama paryenān prāṇaḥ paśavo jīvanaṃ vṛṇaktu
verses.en: She, Kama! she is called the Cow, thy daughter, she who is named Vak and Viraj by sages. By her drive thou my foemen to a distance. May cattle, vital breath, and life forsake them.

verses.sa:
कामस्येन्द्रस्य वरुणस्य राज्ञो विष्णोर्बलेन सवितुः सवेन ।
अग्नेर्होत्रेण प्र णुदे सपत्नांछम्बीव नावमुदकेषु धीरः॥
verses.tr: kāmasyendrasya varuṇasya rājño viṣṇorbalena savituḥ savena agnerhotreṇa pra ṇude sapatnāṃchambīva nāvamudakeṣu dhīraḥ
verses.en: By Kama's might, King Varuna's and Indra's, by Vishnu's strength, and Savitar's instigation, I chase my foes with sacrifice to 'Agni, as a deft steersman drives his boat through waters.

verses.sa:
अध्यक्षो वाजी मम काम उग्रः कृणोतु मह्यमसपत्नमेव।
विश्वे देवा मम नाथं भवन्तु सर्वे देवा हवमा यन्तु म इमम्॥
verses.tr: adhyakṣo vājī mama kāma ugraḥ kṛṇotu mahyamasapatnameva viśve devā mama nāthaṃ bhavantu sarve devā havamā yantu ma imam
verses.en: May Kama, mighty one, my potent warder, give me full freedom from mine adversaries. May all the Deities be my protection, all Gods come nigh to this mine invocation.

verses.sa:
इदमाज्यं घृतवज्जुषाणाः कामज्येष्ठा इह मादयध्वम्।
कृण्वन्तो मह्यमसपत्नमेव॥
verses.tr: idamājyaṃ ghṛtavajjuṣāṇāḥ kāmajyeṣṭhā iha mādayadhvam kṛṇvanto mahyamasapatnameva
verses.en: Accepting this oblation rich with fatness, be joyful here, ye Gods whose chief is Kiama, Giving me freedom from mine adversaries.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राग्नी काम सरथं हि भूत्वा नीचैः सपत्नान् मम पादयाथः ।
तेषां पन्नानामधमा तमांस्यग्ने वास्तून्यनुनिर्दह त्वम्॥
verses.tr: indrāgnī kāma sarathaṃ hi bhūtvā nīcaiḥ sapatnān mama pādayāthaḥ teṣāṃ pannānāmadhamā tamāṃsyagne vāstūnyanunirdaha tvam
verses.en: Ye, Indra, Agni, Kama! come together and cast mine adversaries down beneath me. When they have sunk into the deepest darkness, O Agni, with thy fire consume their dwelling.

verses.sa:
जहि त्वं काम मम ये सपत्ना अन्धा तमांस्यव पादयैनान्।
निरिन्द्रिया अरसाः सन्तु सर्वे मा ते जीविषुः कतमच्चनाहः॥
verses.tr: jahi tvaṃ kāma mama ye sapatnā andhā tamāṃsyava pādayainān nirindriyā arasāḥ santu sarve mā te jīviṣuḥ katamaccanāhaḥ
verses.en: Slay those who are mine enemies, O Kama: headlong to depth of blinding darkness hurl them. Reft be they all of. manly strength and vigour! Let them not have a single day's existence.

verses.sa:
अवधीत् कामो मम ये सपत्ना उरुं लोकमकरन्मह्यमेधतुम्।
मह्यं नमन्तां प्रदिशश्चतस्रो मह्यं षडुर्वीर्घृतमा वहन्तु॥
verses.tr: avadhīt kāmo mama ye sapatnā uruṃ lokamakaranmahyamedhatum mahyaṃ namantāṃ pradiśaścatasro mahyaṃ ṣaḍurvīrghṛtamā vahantu
verses.en: Kama hath slain those who were mine opponents, and given me ample room to grow and prosper. Let the four regions bow them down before me, and let the six expanses bring me fatness.

verses.sa:
तेऽधराञ्चः प्र प्लवन्तां छिन्ना नौरिव बन्धनात्।
न सायकप्रणुत्तानां पुनरस्ति निवर्तनम्॥
verses.tr: te'dharāñcaḥ pra plavantāṃ chinnā nauriva bandhanāt na sāyakapraṇuttānāṃ punarasti nivartanam
verses.en: Let them drift downward like a boat torn from the rope that held it fast. There is no turning I" for those whom our keen arrows have repelled.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्यव इन्द्रो यवः सोमो यवः ।
यवयावानो देवा यावयन्त्वेनम्॥
verses.tr: agniryava indro yavaḥ somo yavaḥ yavayāvāno devā yāvayantvenam
verses.en: Agni averts, Indra averts, and Soma: may the averting Gods avert this foeman:

verses.sa:
असर्ववीरश्चरतु प्रणुत्तो द्वेष्यो मित्राणां परिवर्ग्यः१ स्वानाम्।
उत पृथिव्यामव स्यन्ति विद्युत उग्रो वो देवः प्र मृणत् सपत्नान्॥
verses.tr: asarvavīraścaratu praṇutto dveṣyo mitrāṇāṃ parivargyaḥ1 svānām uta pṛthivyāmava syanti vidyuta ugro vo devaḥ pra mṛṇat sapatnān
verses.en: To be avoided by his friends, detested, repelled, with. few men round him, let him wander. Yea, on the earth descend the lightning-flashes: may the strong God destroy your adversaries.

verses.sa:
च्युता चेयं बृहत्यच्युता च विद्युद् बिभर्ति स्तनयित्नूंश्च सर्वान्।
उद्यन्नादित्यो द्रविणेन तेजसा नीचैः सपत्नान् नुदतां मे सहस्वान्॥
verses.tr: cyutā ceyaṃ bṛhatyacyutā ca vidyud bibharti stanayitnūṃśca sarvān udyannādityo draviṇena tejasā nīcaiḥ sapatnān nudatāṃ me sahasvān
verses.en: This potent lightning nourishes things shaken, and things unshaken yet, and all the thunders. May the Sun, rising with his wealth and splendour, drive in victorious might my foemen downward.

verses.sa:
यत् ते काम शर्म त्रिवरूथमुद्भु ब्रह्म वर्म विततमनतिव्याध्यंऽ कृतम्।
तेन सपत्नान् परि वृङ्ग्धि ये मम पर्येनान् प्राणः पशवो जीवनं वृणक्तु॥
verses.tr: yat te kāma śarma trivarūthamudbhu brahma varma vitatamanativyādhyaṃ' kṛtam tena sapatnān pari vṛṅgdhi ye mama paryenān prāṇaḥ paśavo jīvanaṃ vṛṇaktu
verses.en: Thy firm and triply-barred protection, Kama! thy spell, made weapon-proof extended armour—With that drive thou my foemen to a distance. May cattle, vital breath, and life forsake them.

verses.sa:
येन देवा असुरान् प्राणुदन्त येनेन्द्रो दस्यूनधमं तमो निनाय ।
तेन त्वं काम मम ये सपत्नास्तानस्माल्लोकात् प्र णुदस्व दूरम्॥
verses.tr: yena devā asurān prāṇudanta yenendro dasyūnadhamaṃ tamo nināya tena tvaṃ kāma mama ye sapatnāstānasmāllokāt pra ṇudasva dūram
verses.en: Far from the world wherein we live, O Kama, drive thou my foemen with that selfsame weapon Wherewith the Gods repelled the fiends, and Indra cast down the Dasyus into deepest darkness.

verses.sa:
यथा देवा असुरान् प्राणुदन्त यथेन्द्रो दस्यूनधमं तमो बबाधे।
तथा त्वं काम मम ये सपत्नास्तानस्माल्लोकात् णुदस्व दूरम्॥
verses.tr: yathā devā asurān prāṇudanta yathendro dasyūnadhamaṃ tamo babādhe tathā tvaṃ kāma mama ye sapatnāstānasmāllokāt ṇudasva dūram
verses.en: As Gods repelled the Asuras, and Indra down to the lowest darkness drove the demons, So, Kama, from this world, to distant places, drive thou the men who are mine adversaries.

verses.sa:
कामो जज्ञे प्रथमो नैनं देवा आपुः पितरो न मर्त्याः ।
ततस्त्वमसि ज्यायान् विश्वहा महांस्तस्मै ते काम नम इत् कृणोमि॥
verses.tr: kāmo jajñe prathamo nainaṃ devā āpuḥ pitaro na martyāḥ tatastvamasi jyāyān viśvahā mahāṃstasmai te kāma nama it kṛṇomi
verses.en: First before all sprang Kama into being. Gods, Fathers, mortal men have never matched him. Stronger than these art thou, and great for ever. Kama, to thee, to thee I offer worship.

verses.sa:
यावती द्यावापृथिवी वरिम्णा यावदापः सिष्यदुर्यावदग्निः ।
ततस्त्वमसि ज्यायान् विश्वहा महांस्तस्मै ते काम नम इत् कृणोमि॥
verses.tr: yāvatī dyāvāpṛthivī varimṇā yāvadāpaḥ siṣyaduryāvadagniḥ tatastvamasi jyāyān viśvahā mahāṃstasmai te kāma nama it kṛṇomi
verses.en: Wide as the space which heaven and earth encompass, far as the flow of waters, for as Agni, Stronger than these art thou, and great for ever. Kama, to thee, to thee I offer worship.

verses.sa:
यावतीर्दिशः प्रदिशो विषूचीर्यावतीराशा अभिचक्षणा दिवः ।
ततस्त्वमसि ज्यायान् विश्वहा महांस्तस्मै ते काम नम इत् कृणोमि॥
verses.tr: yāvatīrdiśaḥ pradiśo viṣūcīryāvatīrāśā abhicakṣaṇā divaḥ tatastvamasi jyāyān viśvahā mahāṃstasmai te kāma nama it kṛṇomi
verses.en: Vast as the quarters of the sky and regions that lie between them spread in all directions, vast as celestial tracts and views of heaven, Stronger than these art thou, and great for ever. Kama, to thee, to thee I offer worship.

verses.sa:
यावतीर्भृङ्गा जत्वःऽ कुरूरवो यावतीर्वघा वृक्षसर्प्योऽ बभूवुः ।
ततस्त्वमसि ज्यायान् विश्वहा महांस्तस्मै ते काम नम इत् कृणोमि॥
verses.tr: yāvatīrbhṛṅgā jatvaḥ' kurūravo yāvatīrvaghā vṛkṣasarpyo' babhūvuḥ tatastvamasi jyāyān viśvahā mahāṃstasmai te kāma nama it kṛṇomi
verses.en: Many as are the bees, and bats, and reptiles, and female serpents of the trees, and beetles, Stronger art thou than these, and great for ever. Kama, to thee, to thee I offer worship.

verses.sa:
ज्यायान् निमिषतोऽसि तिष्ठतो ज्यायान्त्समुद्रादसि काम मन्यो ।
ततस्त्वमसि ज्यायान् विश्वहा महांस्तस्मै ते काम नम इत् कृणोमि॥
verses.tr: jyāyān nimiṣato'si tiṣṭhato jyāyāntsamudrādasi kāma manyo tatastvamasi jyāyān viśvahā mahāṃstasmai te kāma nama it kṛṇomi
verses.en: Stronger art thou than aught that stands or twinkles, stronger art thou than ocean, Kama! Manyu! Stronger than these art thou, and great for ever. Kama, to thee, to thee I offer worship.

verses.sa:
न वै वातश्चन काममाप्नोति नाग्निः सूर्यो नोत चन्द्रमाः ।
ततस्त्वमसि ज्यायान् विश्वहा महांस्तस्मै ते काम नम इत् कृणोमि॥
verses.tr: na vai vātaścana kāmamāpnoti nāgniḥ sūryo nota candramāḥ tatastvamasi jyāyān viśvahā mahāṃstasmai te kāma nama it kṛṇomi
verses.en: Not even Vata is the peer of Kama, not Agni, Chandramas the Moon, nor Surya. Stronger than these art thou, and great for ever. Kama, to thee, to thee I offer worship.

verses.sa:
यास्ते शिवास्तन्वःऽ काम भद्रा याभिः सत्यं भवति यद् वृणीषे।
ताभिष्ट्वमस्माँ अभिसंविशस्वान्यत्र पापीरप वेशया धियः॥
verses.tr: yāste śivāstanvaḥ' kāma bhadrā yābhiḥ satyaṃ bhavati yad vṛṇīṣe tābhiṣṭvamasmāṃ abhisaṃviśasvānyatra pāpīrapa veśayā dhiyaḥ
verses.en: Thy lovely and auspicious form, O 'Kama, whereby the thing thou wilt becometh real, With these come thou and make thy home among us, and make malignant thoughts inhabit elsewhere.

sections.label: On the consecration of a newly built house
sections.name: Book 9, hymn 3

verses.en: We loose the ties and fastenings of the house that holds all precious things, The bands of pillars and of stays, the ties of beams that form the roof.
All-wealthy House! each knot and band, each cord that is attached to thee I with my spell untie, as erst Brihaspati disclosed the cave.
He drew them close, he pressed them fast, he made thy knotted bands secure: With Indra's help we loose them as a skilful Slaughterer severs joints.
We loose the bands of thy bamboos, of bolts, of fastening, of thatch, We loose the ties of thy side-posts, O House that holdest all we prize.
We loosen here the ties and bands of straw in bundles, and of clamps, Of all that compasses and binds the Lady Genius of the Home.
We loose the loops which men have bound within thee, loops to tie and hold. Be gracious, when erected, to our bodies, Lady of the Home!
Store-house of Soma, Agni's hall, the ladies' bower, the residence, The seat of Gods art thou, O Goddess House.
We with our incantation loose the net that hath a thousand eyes, The diadem, securely tied and laid upon the central beam.
The man who takes thee as his own, and he who was thy builder, House! Both these, O Lady of the Home, shall live to long-extended years.
There let her come to meet this man. Firm, strongly fastened, and prepared Art thou whose several limbs and joints we part and loosen one by one.
He who collected timber for the work and built thee up, O House, Made thee for coming progeny, Prajapati, the Lord Supreme.
Homage to him! We worship too the giver and the Mansion's lord: Homage to Agni! to the man who serves at holy rites for thee.
Homage to kine and steeds! to all that shall be born within the house! We loose the bonds that fasten thee, mother of multitudes to come!
Agni thou sheltered within, and people with domestic beasts. We loose the bonds that fasten thee, mother of multitudes to come!

All space that lies between the earth and heaven, therewith I take this house for thy possession, And all that measures out the air's mid-region I make a hollow to contain thy treasures. Therewith I take the house for his possession.
Rich in prosperity, rich in milk, founded and built upon the earth, Injure not thy receivers, House who holdest food of every sort!
Grass-covered, clad with straw, the house, like Night, gives rest to man and beast. Thou standest, built upon the earth, like a she-elephant, borne on feet.
I loosen and remove from thee thy covering formed by mats of reed. What Varuna hath firmly closed Mitra shall ope at early morn.
May Indra, Agni, deathless Gods, protect the house where Soma dwells, House that was founded with the prayer, built and erected by the wise.
Nest upon nest hath been imposed, compartment on compartment laid: There man shall propagate his kind, and there shall everything be book
Within the house constructed with two side-posts, or with four, or six, Built with eight side-posts, or with ten, lies Agni like a babe unborn.
Turned to thee, House! I come to thee, innocent, turned to welcome me: For Fire and Water are within, the first chief door of sacrifice.
Water that kills Consumption, free from all Consumption, here I bring. With Agni, the immortal one, I enter and possess the house.
Lay thou no cord or noose on us: a weighty burthen, still be light! Withersoever be our will, O House, we bear thee like a bride.
Now from the east side of the house to the Great Power be homage paid! Hail to the Gods whose due is Hail!
Now from the south side of the house, etc.
Now from the west side of the house, etc.
Now from the north side of the house, etc.
So from the mansion's every side to the Great Power be homage paid! Hail to the Gods whose due is Hail!

sections.label: A glorification of the typical sacrificial bull
sections.name: Book 9, hymn 4

verses.sa:
साहस्रस्त्वेष ऋषभः पयस्वान् विश्वा रूपाणि वक्षणासु बिभ्रत्।
भद्रं दात्रे यजमानाय शीक्षन् बार्हस्पत्य उस्रियस्तन्तुमातान्॥
verses.tr: sāhasrastveṣa ṛṣabhaḥ payasvān viśvā rūpāṇi vakṣaṇāsu bibhrat bhadraṃ dātre yajamānāya śīkṣan bārhaspatya usriyastantumātān
verses.en: The Bull, fierce, thousandfold, filled full of vigour, bearing within his flanks all forms and natures, Brihaspati's Steer, hath stretched the thread, bestowing bliss on the worshipper, the liberal giver.

verses.sa:
अपां यो अग्ने प्रतिमा बभूव प्रभूः सर्वस्मै पृथिवीव देवी।
पिता वत्सानां पतिरघ्न्यानां साहस्रे पोषे अपि नः कृणोतु॥
verses.tr: apāṃ yo agne pratimā babhūva prabhūḥ sarvasmai pṛthivīva devī pitā vatsānāṃ patiraghnyānāṃ sāhasre poṣe api naḥ kṛṇotu
verses.en: He who at first became the Waters' model, a match for everyone, like Earth the Goddess; The husband of the cows, the young calves' father, may he secure us thousandfold abundance.

verses.sa:
पुमानन्तर्वान्त्स्थविरः पयस्वान् वसोः कबन्धमृषभो बिभर्ति ।
तमिन्द्राय पथिभिर्देवयानैर्हुतमग्निर्वहतु जातवेदाः॥
verses.tr: pumānantarvāntsthaviraḥ payasvān vasoḥ kabandhamṛṣabho bibharti tamindrāya pathibhirdevayānairhutamagnirvahatu jātavedāḥ
verses.en: Masculine, pregnant, stedfast, full of vigour, the Bull sustains a trunk of goodly treasure. May Agni Jatavedas bear him offered, on pathways. traversed by the Gods, to Indra.

verses.sa:
पिता वत्सानां पतिरघ्न्यानामथो पिता महतां गर्गराणाम्।
वत्सो जरायु प्रतिधुक् पीयूष आमिक्षा घृतं तद् वस्य रेतः॥
verses.tr: pitā vatsānāṃ patiraghnyānāmatho pitā mahatāṃ gargarāṇām vatso jarāyu pratidhuk pīyūṣa āmikṣā ghṛtaṃ tad vasya retaḥ
verses.en: The husband of the cows, the young: calves' father, father is he of mighty water-eddies. Calf, after-birth, new milk drawn hot, and biestings, curds, butter, that is his best genial humour.

verses.sa:
देवानां भाग उपनाह एषो३पां रस ओषधीनां घृतस्य ।
सोमस्य भक्षमवृणीत शक्रो बृहन्नद्रिरभवद् यच्छरीरम्॥
verses.tr: devānāṃ bhāga upanāha eṣo3pāṃ rasa oṣadhīnāṃ ghṛtasya somasya bhakṣamavṛṇīta śakro bṛhannadrirabhavad yaccharīram
verses.en: He is the Gods' allotted: share and bundle, essence of waters, and of plants, and butter. Sakra elected him, the draught of Soma. What was. his body was a lofty mountain.

verses.sa:
सोमेन पूर्णं कलशं बिभर्षि त्वष्टा रुपाणां जनिता पशूनाम्।
शिवास्ते सन्तु प्रजन्वऽ इह या इमा न्यस्मभ्यं स्वधिते यच्छ या अमूः॥
verses.tr: somena pūrṇaṃ kalaśaṃ bibharṣi tvaṣṭā rupāṇāṃ janitā paśūnām śivāste santu prajanva' iha yā imā nyasmabhyaṃ svadhite yaccha yā amūḥ
verses.en: A beaker filled with Soma juice thou bearest; framer of forms, begetter of the cattle. Kindly to us be these thy wombs here present, and: stay for us, O Axe, those that are yonder.

verses.sa:
आज्यं बिभर्ति घृतमस्य रेतः साहस्रः पोषस्तमु यज्ञमाहुः ।
इन्द्रस्य रूपमृषभो वसानः सो अस्मान् देवाः शिव ऐतु दत्तः॥
verses.tr: ājyaṃ bibharti ghṛtamasya retaḥ sāhasraḥ poṣastamu yajñamāhuḥ indrasya rūpamṛṣabho vasānaḥ so asmān devāḥ śiva aitu dattaḥ
verses.en: He bears oblation, and his seed is butter. Thousandfold plenty; sacrifice they call him. May he, the Bull, wearing the shape of Indra, come: unto us, O Gods, bestowed, with blessing.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्यौजो वरुणस्य बाहू अश्विनोरंसौ मरुतामियं ककुत्।
बृहस्पतिं संभृतमेतमाहुर्ये धीरासः कवयो ये मनीषिणः॥
verses.tr: indrasyaujo varuṇasya bāhū aśvinoraṃsau marutāmiyaṃ kakut bṛhaspatiṃ saṃbhṛtametamāhurye dhīrāsaḥ kavayo ye manīṣiṇaḥ
verses.en: Both arms of Varuna, and Indra's vigour, the Maruts' hump is he, the Asvins' shoulders. They who are sages, bards endowed: with wisdom, call him Brihaspati compact and heightened.

verses.sa:
दैवीर्विशः पयस्वाना तनोषि त्वामिन्द्रं त्वां सरस्वन्तमाहुः ।
सहस्रं स एकमुखा ददाति यो ब्राह्मण ऋषभमाजुहोति॥
verses.tr: daivīrviśaḥ payasvānā tanoṣi tvāmindraṃ tvāṃ sarasvantamāhuḥ sahasraṃ sa ekamukhā dadāti yo brāhmaṇa ṛṣabhamājuhoti
verses.en: Thou, vigorous, reachest to the tribes of heaven. Thee they call Indra, thee they call Sarasvan. Turned to one aim, that Brahman gives a thousand who offers up the Bull as his oblation.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पतिः सविता ते वयो दधौ त्वष्टुर्वायोः पर्यात्मा त आभृतः ।
अन्तरिक्षे मनसा त्वा जुहोमि बर्हिष्टे द्यावापृथिवी उभे स्ताम्॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspatiḥ savitā te vayo dadhau tvaṣṭurvāyoḥ paryātmā ta ābhṛtaḥ antarikṣe manasā tvā juhomi barhiṣṭe dyāvāpṛthivī ubhe stām
verses.en: Brihaspati, Savitar gave thee vital vigour: thy breath was brought from Tvashtar and from Vayu. In thought I offer thee in air's mid-region. Thy sacrificial grass be Earth and Heaven!

verses.sa:
य इन्द्र इव देवेषु गोष्वेति विवावदत्।
तस्य ऋषभस्याङ्गानि ब्रह्मा सं स्तौतु भद्रया॥
verses.tr: ya indra iva deveṣu goṣveti vivāvadat tasya ṛṣabhasyāṅgāni brahmā saṃ stautu bhadrayā
verses.en: Let the priest joyfully extol the limbs and members of the Bull Who moved and roared among the kine as Indra moves among the Gods.

verses.sa:
पार्श्वे आस्तामनुमत्या भगस्यास्तामनूवृजौ ।
अष्ठीवन्तावब्रवीन्मित्रो ममैतौ केवलाविति॥
verses.tr: pārśve āstāmanumatyā bhagasyāstāmanūvṛjau aṣṭhīvantāvabravīnmitro mamaitau kevalāviti
verses.en: The sides must be Anumati's, and both rib-pieces Bhaga's share. Of the knee-bones hath Mitra said, Both these are mine, and only mine.

verses.sa:
भसदासीदादित्यानां श्रोणी आस्तां बृहस्पतेः ।
पुच्छं वातस्य देवस्य तेन धूनोत्योषधीः॥
verses.tr: bhasadāsīdādityānāṃ śroṇī āstāṃ bṛhaspateḥ pucchaṃ vātasya devasya tena dhūnotyoṣadhīḥ
verses.en: The Adityas claim the hinder parts, the loins must be Brihaspati's. Vata, the God, receives the tail: he stirs the plants and herbs therewith.

verses.sa:
गुदा आसन्त्सिनीवाल्याः सूर्यायास्त्वचमब्रुवन्।
उत्थातुरब्रुवन् पद ऋषभं यदकल्पयन्॥
verses.tr: gudā āsantsinīvālyāḥ sūryāyāstvacamabruvan utthāturabruvan pada ṛṣabhaṃ yadakalpayan
verses.en: To Surya they assigned the skin, to Sinivali inward parts. The Slaughterer hath the feet, they said, when they distributed the Bull.

verses.sa:
क्रोड आसीज्जामिशंसस्य सोमस्य कलशो धृतः ।
देवाः संगत्य यत् सर्व ऋषभं व्यकल्पयन्॥
verses.tr: kroḍa āsījjāmiśaṃsasya somasya kalaśo dhṛtaḥ devāḥ saṃgatya yat sarva ṛṣabhaṃ vyakalpayan
verses.en: They made a jest of kindred's curse: a jar of Soma juice was set, What time the deities, convened, assigned the Bull's divided parts.

verses.sa:
ते कुष्ठिकाः सरमायै कूर्मेभ्यो अदधुः शफान्।
ऊबध्यमस्य कीटेभ्यः श्ववर्तेभ्यो अधारयन्॥
verses.tr: te kuṣṭhikāḥ saramāyai kūrmebhyo adadhuḥ śaphān ūbadhyamasya kīṭebhyaḥ śvavartebhyo adhārayan
verses.en: They gave the hooves to tortoises, to Sarama scraps of the feet: His undigested food they gave to worms and things that creep and crawl.

verses.sa:
शृङ्गाभ्यां रक्ष ऋषत्यवर्तिं हन्ति चक्षुषा ।
शृणोति भद्रं कर्णाभ्यां गवां यः पतिरघ्न्यः॥
verses.tr: śṛṅgābhyāṃ rakṣa ṛṣatyavartiṃ hanti cakṣuṣā śṛṇoti bhadraṃ karṇābhyāṃ gavāṃ yaḥ patiraghnyaḥ
verses.en: That Bull, the husband of the kine, pierces the demons with his horns, Banishes famine with his eye, and hears good tidings with his ears.

verses.sa:
शतयाजं स यजते नैनं दुन्वन्त्यग्नयः ।
जिन्वन्ति विश्वे तं देवा यो ब्राह्मण ऋषभमाजुहोति॥
verses.tr: śatayājaṃ sa yajate nainaṃ dunvantyagnayaḥ jinvanti viśve taṃ devā yo brāhmaṇa ṛṣabhamājuhoti
verses.en: With hundred sacrifices he worships: the fires consume him not: All Gods promote the Brahman who offers the Bull in sacrifice.

verses.sa:
ब्राह्मणेभ्य ऋषभं दत्त्वा वरीयः कृणुते मनः ।
पुष्टिं सो अघ्न्यानां स्वे गोष्ठेऽव पश्यते॥
verses.tr: brāhmaṇebhya ṛṣabhaṃ dattvā varīyaḥ kṛṇute manaḥ puṣṭiṃ so aghnyānāṃ sve goṣṭhe'va paśyate
verses.en: He who hath given away the Bull to Brahmans frees and cheers his soul. In his own cattle-pen he sees the growth and increase of his cows.

verses.sa:
गावः सन्तु प्रजाः सन्त्वथो अस्तु तनूबलम्।
तत् सर्वमनु मन्यन्तां देवा ऋषभदायिने॥
verses.tr: gāvaḥ santu prajāḥ santvatho astu tanūbalam tat sarvamanu manyantāṃ devā ṛṣabhadāyine
verses.en: Let there be cattle, let there be bodily strength and progeny: All this may the Gods kindly grant to him who gives away the Bull.

verses.sa:
अयं पिपान इन्द्र इद् रयिं दधातु चेतनीम्।
अयं धेनुं सुदुघां नित्यवत्सां वशं दुहां विपश्चितं परो दिवः॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ pipāna indra id rayiṃ dadhātu cetanīm ayaṃ dhenuṃ sudughāṃ nityavatsāṃ vaśaṃ duhāṃ vipaścitaṃ paro divaḥ
verses.en: Indra here verily hath rejoiced: let him bestow conspicuous wealth. May he draw forth at will from yonder side of heaven a deft cow, good to milk, whose calf is never wanting.

verses.sa:
पिशङ्गरूपो नभसो वयोधा ऐन्द्रः शुष्मो विश्वरूपो न आगन्।
आयुरस्मभ्यं दधत् प्रजां च रायश्च पोषैरभि नः सचताम्॥
verses.tr: piśaṅgarūpo nabhaso vayodhā aindraḥ śuṣmo viśvarūpo na āgan āyurasmabhyaṃ dadhat prajāṃ ca rāyaśca poṣairabhi naḥ sacatām
verses.en: With close connexion mingle with the cows in this our cattle-pen: Mingle, the Bull's prolific flow, and, Indra! thine heroic strength!

verses.sa:
उपेहोपपर्चनास्मिन् गोष्ठ उप पृञ्च नः ।
उप ऋषभस्य यद् रेत उपेन्द्र तव वीर्यऽम्॥
एतं वो युवानं प्रति दध्मो अत्र तेन क्रीडन्तीश्चरत वशाँ अनु ।
मा नो हासिष्ट जनुषा सुभागा रायश्च पोषैरभि नः सचध्वम्॥
verses.tr: upehopaparcanāsmin goṣṭha upa pṛñca naḥ upa ṛṣabhasya yad reta upendra tava vīrya'm etaṃ vo yuvānaṃ prati dadhmo atra tena krīḍantīścarata vaśāṃ anu mā no hāsiṣṭa januṣā subhāgā rāyaśca poṣairabhi naḥ sacadhvam
verses.en: Here we restore this Bull, your youthful leader: sporting with him, go, wander at your pleasure. Ne'er, j wealthy ones! may he be reft of offspring; and do ye favour us with growth of riches.

sections.label: A glorification of a sacrificial goat
sections.name: Book 9, hymn 5

verses.sa:
आ नयैतमा रभस्व सुकृतां लोकमपि गच्छतु प्रजानन्।
तीर्त्वा तमांसि बहुधा महान्त्यजो नाकमा क्रमतां तृतीयम्॥
verses.tr: ā nayaitamā rabhasva sukṛtāṃ lokamapi gacchatu prajānan tīrtvā tamāṃsi bahudhā mahāntyajo nākamā kramatāṃ tṛtīyam
verses.en: Seize him and bring him hither. Let him travel, foreknowing, to the regions of the pious. Crossing in many a place the mighty darkness, let the Goat mount to the third heaven above us.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राय भागं परि त्वा नयाम्यस्मिन् यज्ञे यजमानाय सूरिम्।
ये नो द्विषन्त्यनु तान् रभस्वानागसो यजमानस्य वीराः॥
verses.tr: indrāya bhāgaṃ pari tvā nayāmyasmin yajñe yajamānāya sūrim ye no dviṣantyanu tān rabhasvānāgaso yajamānasya vīrāḥ
verses.en: I bring thee hither as a share for Indra; prince, at this sacrifice, for him who worships. Grasp firmly from behind all those who hate us: so let the sacrificed men be sinless.

verses.sa:
प्र पदोऽव नेनिग्धि दुश्चरितं यच्चचार शुद्धैः शफैरा क्रमतां प्रजानन्।
तीर्त्वा तमांसि बहुधा विपश्यन्नजो नाकमा क्रमतां तृतीयम्॥
verses.tr: pra pado'va nenigdhi duścaritaṃ yaccacāra śuddhaiḥ śaphairā kramatāṃ prajānan tīrtvā tamāṃsi bahudhā vipaśyannajo nākamā kramatāṃ tṛtīyam
verses.en: Wash from his feet all trace of evil-doing: foreknowing, with cleansed hooves let him go upward. Gazing on many a spot, crossing the darkness, let the Goat mount to the third heaven above us.

verses.sa:
अनुच्छ्य श्यामेन त्वचमेतां विशस्तर्यथापर्व१सिना माभि मंस्थाः ।
माभि द्रुहः परुशः कल्पयैनं तृतीये नाके अधि वि श्रयैनम्॥
verses.tr: anucchya śyāmena tvacametāṃ viśastaryathāparva1sinā mābhi maṃsthāḥ mābhi druhaḥ paruśaḥ kalpayainaṃ tṛtīye nāke adhi vi śrayainam
verses.en: Cut up this skin with the grey knife, Dissector! dividing joint from joint, and mangle nothing. Do him no injury: limb by limb arrange him, and send him up to the third cope of heaven.

verses.sa:
ऋचा कुम्भीमध्यग्नौ श्रयाम्या सिञ्चोदकमव धेह्येनम्।
पर्याधत्ताग्निना शमितारः शृतो गच्छतु सुकृतां यत्र लोकः॥
verses.tr: ṛcā kumbhīmadhyagnau śrayāmyā siñcodakamava dhehyenam paryādhattāgninā śamitāraḥ śṛto gacchatu sukṛtāṃ yatra lokaḥ
verses.en: With verse upon the fire I set the caldron: pour in the water; lay him down within it! Encompass him with fire, ye Immolators. Cooked, let him reach the world where dwell the righteous.

verses.sa:
उत् क्रामातः परि चेदतप्तस्तप्ताच्चरोरधि नाकं तृतीयम्।
अग्नेरग्निरधि सं बभूविथ ज्योतिष्मन्तमभि लोकं जयैतम्॥
verses.tr: ut krāmātaḥ pari cedataptastaptāccaroradhi nākaṃ tṛtīyam agneragniradhi saṃ babhūvitha jyotiṣmantamabhi lokaṃ jayaitam
verses.en: Hence come thou forth, vexed by no pain or torment. Mount to the third heaven from the heated vessel. As fire out of the fire hast thou arisen. Conquer and win this lucid world of splendour.

verses.sa:
अजो अग्निरजमु ज्योतिराहुरजं जीवता ब्रह्मणे देयमाहुः ।
अजस्तमांस्यप हन्ति दूरमस्मिंल्लोके श्रद्दधानेन दत्तः॥
verses.tr: ajo agnirajamu jyotirāhurajaṃ jīvatā brahmaṇe deyamāhuḥ ajastamāṃsyapa hanti dūramasmiṃlloke śraddadhānena dattaḥ
verses.en: The Goat is Agni: light they call him, saying that living man must give him to the Brahman. Given in this world by a devout believer, the Goat dispels and drives afar the darkness.

verses.sa:
पञ्चौदनः पञ्चधा वि क्रमतामाक्रंस्यमानस्त्रीणि ज्योतींषि ।
ईजानानां सुकृतां प्रेहि मध्यं तृतीये नाके अधि वि श्रयस्व॥
verses.tr: pañcaudanaḥ pañcadhā vi kramatāmākraṃsyamānastrīṇi jyotīṃṣi ījānānāṃ sukṛtāṃ prehi madhyaṃ tṛtīye nāke adhi vi śrayasva
verses.en: Let the Pafichaudana Goat, about to visit the three? lights, pass away in five divisions. Go midst the pious who have paid their worship, and, parted, dwell on the third cope of heaven.

verses.sa:
अजा रोह सुकृतां यत्र लोकः शरभो न चत्तोऽति दुर्गान्येषः ।
पञ्चौदनो ब्रह्मणे दीयमानः स दातारं तृप्त्या तर्पयाति॥
verses.tr: ajā roha sukṛtāṃ yatra lokaḥ śarabho na catto'ti durgānyeṣaḥ pañcaudano brahmaṇe dīyamānaḥ sa dātāraṃ tṛptyā tarpayāti
verses.en: Rise to that world, O Goat, where dwell the righteous: pass, like a Sarabha veiled, all difficult places. The Goat Pafichaudana, given to a Brahman, shall with all fulness satisfy the giver.

verses.sa:
अजस्त्रिनाके त्रिदिवे त्रिपृष्ठे नाकस्य पृष्ठे ददिवांसं दधाति ।
पञ्चौदनो ब्रह्मणे दीयमानो विश्वरूपा धेनुः कामदुघास्येका॥
verses.tr: ajastrināke tridive tripṛṣṭhe nākasya pṛṣṭhe dadivāṃsaṃ dadhāti pañcaudano brahmaṇe dīyamāno viśvarūpā dhenuḥ kāmadughāsyekā
verses.en: The Goat Pauchaudana, given to a Brahman, sets the bestower on the pitch of heaven, In the third vault, third sky, third ridge. One only Cow omniform art thou, that yields all wishes.

verses.sa:
एतद् वो ज्योतिः पितरस्तृतीयं पञ्चौदनं ब्रह्मणेऽजं ददाति ।
अजस्तमांस्यप हन्ति दूरमस्मिंल्लोके श्रद्दधानेन दत्तः॥
verses.tr: etad vo jyotiḥ pitarastṛtīyaṃ pañcaudanaṃ brahmaṇe'jaṃ dadāti ajastamāṃsyapa hanti dūramasmiṃlloke śraddadhānena dattaḥ
verses.en: I That is the third light that is yours, ye Fathers. He gives the Goat Pafichaudana to the Brahman. Given in this world by the devout believer, the Goat dispels and drives afar the darkness.

verses.sa:
ईजानानां सुकृतां लोकमीप्सन् पञ्चौदनं ब्रह्मणेऽजं ददाति ।
स व्याऽप्तिमभि लोकं जयैतं शिवो३ऽस्मभ्यं प्रतिगृहीतो अस्तु॥
verses.tr: ījānānāṃ sukṛtāṃ lokamīpsan pañcaudanaṃ brahmaṇe'jaṃ dadāti sa vyā'ptimabhi lokaṃ jayaitaṃ śivo3'smabhyaṃ pratigṛhīto astu
verses.en: Seeking the world of good men who have worshipped, he gives the Goat Pafichaudana to the Brahman. Win thou this world as thy complete possession. Auspicious unto us be he, accepted!

verses.sa:
अजो ह्य१ग्नेरजनिष्ट शोकाद् विप्रो विप्रस्य सहसो विपश्चित्।
इष्टं पूर्तमभिपूर्तं वषट्कृतं तद् देवा ऋतुशः कल्पयन्तु॥
verses.tr: ajo hya1gnerajaniṣṭa śokād vipro viprasya sahaso vipaścit iṣṭaṃ pūrtamabhipūrtaṃ vaṣaṭkṛtaṃ tad devā ṛtuśaḥ kalpayantu
verses.en: Truly the Goat sprang from the glow of Agni, inspired as sage with alla sage's power. Sacrifice, filled, filled full, offered with Vashat—this let the Gods arrange at proper seasons.

verses.sa:
अमोतं वासो दद्याद्धिरण्यमपि दक्षिणाम्।
तथा लोकान्त्समाप्नोति ये दिव्या ये च पार्थिवाः॥
verses.tr: amotaṃ vāso dadyāddhiraṇyamapi dakṣiṇām tathā lokāntsamāpnoti ye divyā ye ca pārthivāḥ
verses.en: Home-woven raiment let him give, and gold as guerdon to the priests. So he obtains completely all celestial and terrestrial worlds.

verses.sa:
एतास्त्वाजोप यन्तु धाराः सोम्या देवीर्घृतपृष्ठा मधुश्चुतः ।
स्तभान पृथिवीमुत द्यां नाकस्य पृष्ठेऽधि सप्तरश्मौ॥
verses.tr: etāstvājopa yantu dhārāḥ somyā devīrghṛtapṛṣṭhā madhuścutaḥ stabhāna pṛthivīmuta dyāṃ nākasya pṛṣṭhe'dhi saptaraśmau
verses.en: Near to thee, Goat! approach these streams of Soma, divine, distilling meath, bedecked with butter! Stay thou the earth and sky and fix them firmly up on the seven-rayed pitch and height of heaven.

verses.sa:
अजो३स्यज स्वर्गोऽसि त्वया लोकमङ्गिरसः प्राजानन्।
तं लोकं पुण्यं प्र ज्ञेषम्॥
verses.tr: ajo3syaja svargo'si tvayā lokamaṅgirasaḥ prājānan taṃ lokaṃ puṇyaṃ pra jñeṣam
verses.en: Unborn art thou, O Goat: to heaven thou goest. Through thee Angirases knew that radiant region. So may I know that holy world.

verses.sa:
येना सहस्रं वहसि येनाग्ने सर्ववेदसम्।
तेनेमं यज्ञं नो वह स्वऽर्देवेषु गन्तवे॥
verses.tr: yenā sahasraṃ vahasi yenāgne sarvavedasam tenemaṃ yajñaṃ no vaha sva'rdeveṣu gantave
verses.en: Convey our sacrifice to heaven, that it may reach the Gods, with that Whereby thou, Agni, bearest wealth in thousands, and all precious things.

verses.sa:
अजः पक्वः स्वर्गे लोके दधाति पञ्चौदनो निरृतिं बाधमानः ।
तेन लोकान्त्सूर्यवतो जयेम॥
verses.tr: ajaḥ pakvaḥ svarge loke dadhāti pañcaudano nirṛtiṃ bādhamānaḥ tena lokāntsūryavato jayema
verses.en: The Goat Pafichaudana, when cooked, transported, repelling Nirriti, to the world of Svarga. By him may we win worlds which Surya brightens.

verses.sa:
यं ब्राह्मणे निदधे यं च विक्षु या विप्रुष ओदनानामजस्य ।
सर्वं तदग्ने सुकृतस्य लोके जानीतान्नः संगमने पथीनाम्॥
verses.tr: yaṃ brāhmaṇe nidadhe yaṃ ca vikṣu yā vipruṣa odanānāmajasya sarvaṃ tadagne sukṛtasya loke jānītānnaḥ saṃgamane pathīnām
verses.en: The droppings of the Odanas attending the Goat which I have lodged with priest or people—May all this know us in the world of virtue, O Agni, at the meeting of the pathways.

verses.sa:
अजो वा इदमग्ने व्यऽक्रमत तस्योर इयमभवद् द्यौः पृष्ठम्।
अन्तरिक्षं मध्यं दिशः पार्श्वे समुद्रौ कुक्षी॥
verses.tr: ajo vā idamagne vya'kramata tasyora iyamabhavad dyauḥ pṛṣṭham antarikṣaṃ madhyaṃ diśaḥ pārśve samudrau kukṣī
verses.en: This Unborn cleft apart in the beginning: his breast became the earth, his back was heaven. His middle was the air, his sides the regions; the hollows of his belly formed both oceans.

verses.sa:
सत्यं चर्तं च चक्षुषी विश्वं सत्यं श्रद्धा प्राणो विराट् शिरः ।
एष वा अपरिमितो यज्ञो यदजः पञ्चौदनः॥
verses.tr: satyaṃ cartaṃ ca cakṣuṣī viśvaṃ satyaṃ śraddhā prāṇo virāṭ śiraḥ eṣa vā aparimito yajño yadajaḥ pañcaudanaḥ
verses.en: His eyes were Truth and Right. The whole together was Truth: Viraj his head, and Faith his breathing. This Goat Pauchaudana was indeed a sacrifice unlimited.

verses.sa:
अपरिमितमेव यज्ञमाप्नोत्यपरिमितं लोकमव रुन्धे ।
यो३ऽजं पञ्चौदनं दक्षिणाज्योतिषं ददाति॥
verses.tr: aparimitameva yajñamāpnotyaparimitaṃ lokamava rundhe yo3'jaṃ pañcaudanaṃ dakṣiṇājyotiṣaṃ dadāti
verses.en: A boundless sacrifice he performs, he wins himself a boundless world: Who gives the Goat Pauchaudana illumined with a priestly fee.

verses.sa:
नास्यास्थीनि भिन्द्यान्न मज्ज्ञो निर्धयेत्।
सर्वमेनं समादायेदमिदं प्र वेशयेत्॥
verses.tr: nāsyāsthīni bhindyānna majjño nirdhayet sarvamenaṃ samādāyedamidaṃ pra veśayet
verses.en: Let him not break the victim's bones, let him not suck the marrow out. Let the man, taking him entire, here, even here deposit him.

verses.sa:
इदमिदमेवास्य रूपं भवति तेनैनं सं गमयति ।
इषं मह ऊर्जमस्मै दुहे यो३ऽजं पञ्चौदनं दक्षिणाज्योतिषं ददाति॥
verses.tr: idamidamevāsya rūpaṃ bhavati tenainaṃ saṃ gamayati iṣaṃ maha ūrjamasmai duhe yo3'jaṃ pañcaudanaṃ dakṣiṇājyotiṣaṃ dadāti
verses.en: 'This, even this is his true from: the man uniteth him therewith. Food, greatness, strength he bringeth him who giveth the Goat Pauchaudana illumed with guerdon.

verses.sa:
पञ्च रुक्मा पञ्च नवानि वस्त्रा पञ्चास्मै धेनवः कामदुघा भवन्ति ।
यो३जं पञ्चौदनं दक्षिणाज्योतिषं ददाति॥
verses.tr: pañca rukmā pañca navāni vastrā pañcāsmai dhenavaḥ kāmadughā bhavanti yo3jaṃ pañcaudanaṃ dakṣiṇājyotiṣaṃ dadāti
verses.en: The five gold pieces, and the five new garments, and the five milch-kine yield him all his wishes Who gives the Goat Pafichaudana illumined with a priestly fee.

verses.sa:
पञ्च रुक्मा ज्योतिरस्मै भवन्ति वर्म वासांसि तन्वेऽ भवन्ति ।
स्वर्गं लोकमश्नुते यो३जं पञ्चौदनं दक्षिणाज्योतिषं ददाति॥
verses.tr: pañca rukmā jyotirasmai bhavanti varma vāsāṃsi tanve' bhavanti svargaṃ lokamaśnute yo3jaṃ pañcaudanaṃ dakṣiṇājyotiṣaṃ dadāti
verses.en: The five gold pieces are a light to light him, robes become armour to defend his body; He winneth Svarga as his home who giveth the Goat Pafichaudana illumed with bounty.

verses.sa:
या पूर्वं पतिं वित्त्वाथान्यं विन्दतेऽपरम्।
पञ्चौदनं च तावजं ददातो न वि योषतः॥
verses.tr: yā pūrvaṃ patiṃ vittvāthānyaṃ vindate'param pañcaudanaṃ ca tāvajaṃ dadāto na vi yoṣataḥ
verses.en: When she who hath been wedded finds a second husband afterward, The twain shall not be parted if they give the Goat Pauchaudana.

verses.sa:
समानलोको भवति पुनर्भुवापरः पतिः ।
यो३जं पञ्चौदनं दक्षिणाज्योतिषं ददाति॥
verses.tr: samānaloko bhavati punarbhuvāparaḥ patiḥ yo3jaṃ pañcaudanaṃ dakṣiṇājyotiṣaṃ dadāti
verses.en: One world with the re-wedded wife becomes the second husband's home Who gives the Goat Pafchaudana illumined with the priestly fee.

verses.sa:
अनुपूर्ववत्सां धेनुमनड्वाहमुपबर्हणम्।
वासो हिरण्यं दत्त्वा ते यन्ति दिवमुत्तमाम्॥
verses.tr: anupūrvavatsāṃ dhenumanaḍvāhamupabarhaṇam vāso hiraṇyaṃ dattvā te yanti divamuttamām
verses.en: They who have given a cow who drops a calf each Season, or an ox, A coverlet, a robe, or gold, go to the loftiest sphere of heaven.

verses.sa:
आत्मानं पितरं पुत्रं पौत्रं पितामहम्।
जायां जनित्रीं मातरं ये प्रियास्तानुप ह्वये॥
verses.tr: ātmānaṃ pitaraṃ putraṃ pautraṃ pitāmaham jāyāṃ janitrīṃ mātaraṃ ye priyāstānupa hvaye
verses.en: Himself, the father and the son, the grandson, and the father's sire, Mother, wife, her who bore his babes, all the beloved ones I call.

verses.sa:
यो वै नैदाघं नामर्तुं वेद । एष वै नैदाघो नामर्तुर्यदजः पञ्चौदनः ।
निरेवाप्रियस्य भ्रातृव्यस्य श्रियं दहति भवत्यात्मना ।
यो३जं पञ्चौदनं दक्षिणाज्योतिषं ददाति॥
verses.tr: yo vai naidāghaṃ nāmartuṃ veda eṣa vai naidāgho nāmarturyadajaḥ pañcaudanaḥ nirevāpriyasya bhrātṛvyasya śriyaṃ dahati bhavatyātmanā yo3jaṃ pañcaudanaṃ dakṣiṇājyotiṣaṃ dadāti
verses.en: The man who knows the season named the Scorching—the Goat Pauchaudana is this scorching season He lives himself, he verily burns up his hated rival's fame, Who gives the the Goat Pauchaudana illumined with the priestly fee.

verses.sa:
यो वै कुर्वन्तं नामर्तुं वेद । कुर्वतींकुर्वतीमेवाप्रियस्य भ्रातृव्यस्य श्रियमा दत्ते ।
एष वै कुर्वन्नामर्तुर्यदजः पञ्चौदनः ।
निरेवाप्रियस्य भ्रातृव्यस्य श्रियं दहति भवत्यात्मना।
यो३जं पञ्चौदनं दक्षिनाज्योतिषं ददाति॥
verses.tr: yo vai kurvantaṃ nāmartuṃ veda kurvatīṃkurvatīmevāpriyasya bhrātṛvyasya śriyamā datte eṣa vai kurvannāmarturyadajaḥ pañcaudanaḥ nirevāpriyasya bhrātṛvyasya śriyaṃ dahati bhavatyātmanā yo3jaṃ pañcaudanaṃ dakṣinājyotiṣaṃ dadāti
verses.en: The man who knows the season called the Working takes to himself the active fame, his hated rival's active fame. The Goat Pafichaudana is this Working season. He lives himself, etc.

verses.sa:
यो वै संयन्तं नामर्तुं वेद । संयतींसंयतीमेवाप्रियस्य भ्रातृव्यस्य श्रियमा दत्ते ।
एष वै संयन्नामर्तुर्यदजः पञ्चौदनः ।
निरेवाप्रियस्य भ्रातृव्यस्य श्रियं दहति भवत्यात्मना।
यो३जं पञ्चौदनं दक्षिणाज्योतिषं ददाति॥
verses.tr: yo vai saṃyantaṃ nāmartuṃ veda saṃyatīṃsaṃyatīmevāpriyasya bhrātṛvyasya śriyamā datte eṣa vai saṃyannāmarturyadajaḥ pañcaudanaḥ nirevāpriyasya bhrātṛvyasya śriyaṃ dahati bhavatyātmanā yo3jaṃ pañcaudanaṃ dakṣiṇājyotiṣaṃ dadāti
verses.en: The man who knows the season called the Meeting takes to himself the gathering fame, his hated rival's gathering fame. The Goat Pauchaudana is this Meeting season.

verses.sa:
यो वै पिन्वन्तं नामर्तुं वेद ।
पिन्वतींपिन्वतीमेवाप्रियस्य भ्रातृव्यस्य श्रियमा दत्ते ।
एष वै पिन्वन्नामर्तुर्यदजः पञ्चौदनः ।
निरेवाप्रियस्य भ्रातृव्यस्य श्रियं दहति भवत्यात्मना।
यो३जं पञ्चौदनं दक्षिणाज्योतिषं ददाति॥
verses.tr: yo vai pinvantaṃ nāmartuṃ veda pinvatīṃpinvatīmevāpriyasya bhrātṛvyasya śriyamā datte eṣa vai pinvannāmarturyadajaḥ pañcaudanaḥ nirevāpriyasya bhrātṛvyasya śriyaṃ dahati bhavatyātmanā yo3jaṃ pañcaudanaṃ dakṣiṇājyotiṣaṃ dadāti
verses.en: The man who knows the season called the Swelling takes to himself the swelling fame, his hated rival's swelling fame. The Goat Pafichaudana is this Swelling season. He lives himself, ete.

verses.sa:
यो वा उद्यन्तं नामर्तुं वेद ।
उद्यतीमुद्यतीमेवाप्रियस्य भ्रातृव्यस्य श्रियमा दत्ते ।
एष वा उद्यन्न्नामर्तुर्यदजः पञ्चौदनः ।
निरेवाप्रियस्य भ्रातृव्यस्य श्रियं दहति भवत्यात्मना।
यो३जं पञ्चौदनं दक्षिणाज्योतिषं ददाति॥
verses.tr: yo vā udyantaṃ nāmartuṃ veda udyatīmudyatīmevāpriyasya bhrātṛvyasya śriyamā datte eṣa vā udyannnāmarturyadajaḥ pañcaudanaḥ nirevāpriyasya bhrātṛvyasya śriyaṃ dahati bhavatyātmanā yo3jaṃ pañcaudanaṃ dakṣiṇājyotiṣaṃ dadāti
verses.en: The man who knows the season called the Rising takes to himself the rising fame, his hated rival's rising fame. The Goat Pafichaudana is this Rising season.

verses.sa:
यो वा अभिभुवं नामर्तुं वेद ।
अभिभवन्तीमभिभवन्तीमेवाप्रियस्य भ्रातृव्यस्य श्रियमा दत्ते ।
एष वा अभिभूर्नामर्तुर्यदजः पञ्चौदनः ।
निरेवाप्रियस्य भ्रातृव्यस्य श्रियं दहति भवत्यात्मना ।
यो३जं पञ्चौदनं दक्षिनाज्योतिषं ददाति॥
verses.tr: yo vā abhibhuvaṃ nāmartuṃ veda abhibhavantīmabhibhavantīmevāpriyasya bhrātṛvyasya śriyamā datte eṣa vā abhibhūrnāmarturyadajaḥ pañcaudanaḥ nirevāpriyasya bhrātṛvyasya śriyaṃ dahati bhavatyātmanā yo3jaṃ pañcaudanaṃ dakṣinājyotiṣaṃ dadāti
verses.en: The man who knows the season called Surpassing takes to himself the conquering fame, his hated rival's conquering fame. The Goat Pafichaudana is this Conquering season. He lives himself, he verily burns up his hated rival's fame Who gives the Goat Pafichaudana illumined with a priestly fee.

verses.sa:
अजं च पचत पञ्च चौदनान्।
सर्वा दिशः संमनसः सध्रीचीः सान्तर्देशाः प्रति गृह्णन्तु त एतम्॥
verses.tr: ajaṃ ca pacata pañca caudanān sarvā diśaḥ saṃmanasaḥ sadhrīcīḥ sāntardeśāḥ prati gṛhṇantu ta etam
verses.en: He cooks the Goat and the five boiled rice messes. May the united Quarters, all accordant, and intermediate points, accept him from thee.

verses.sa: तास्ते रक्षन्तु तव तुभ्यमेतं ताभ्य आज्यं हविरिदं जुहोमि॥
verses.tr: tāste rakṣantu tava tubhyametaṃ tābhya ājyaṃ haviridaṃ juhomi
verses.en: May these preserve him for thee. Here I offer to these the molten butter as oblation.

sections.label: A glorification of hospitable reception of guests
sections.name: Book 9, hymn 6

verses.sa: यो विद्याद् ब्रह्म प्रत्यक्षं परूंषि यस्य संभारा ऋचो यस्यानूक्यऽम्॥
verses.tr: yo vidyād brahma pratyakṣaṃ parūṃṣi yasya saṃbhārā ṛco yasyānūkya'm
verses.en: Whoso will know Prayer with immediate knowledge, whose members are the stuff, whose spine the Verses:

verses.sa: सामानि यस्य लोमानि यजुर्हृदयमुच्यते परिस्तरणामिद्धविः॥
verses.tr: sāmāni yasya lomāni yajurhṛdayamucyate paristaraṇāmiddhaviḥ
verses.en: Whose hairs are psalms, whose heart; is called the Yajus, whose coverlet is verily oblation—

verses.sa: यद् वा अतिथिपतिरतिथीन् प्रतिपश्यति देवयजनं प्रेक्षते॥
verses.tr: yad vā atithipatiratithīn pratipaśyati devayajanaṃ prekṣate
verses.en: Verily when a host looks at his guests he looks at the place of sacrifice to the Gods.

verses.sa: यदभिवदति दीक्षामुपैति यदुदकं याचत्यपः प्र णयति॥
verses.tr: yadabhivadati dīkṣāmupaiti yadudakaṃ yācatyapaḥ pra ṇayati
verses.en: When he salutes them reverently he undergoes preparation for a religious ceremony: when he calls for water, he solemnly brings sacrificial water.

verses.sa: या एव यज्ञ आपः प्रणीयन्ते ता एव ताः॥
verses.tr: yā eva yajña āpaḥ praṇīyante tā eva tāḥ
verses.en: The water that is solemnly brought at a sacrifice is this same water.

verses.sa: यत् तर्पणमाहरन्ति य एवाग्नीषोमीयः पशुर्बध्यते स एव सः॥
verses.tr: yat tarpaṇamāharanti ya evāgnīṣomīyaḥ paśurbadhyate sa eva saḥ
verses.en: The libation which they bring, the sacrificial victim dedicated to Agni and Soma which is tied to the post, that, verily, is this man.

verses.sa: यदावसथान् कल्पयन्ति सदोहविर्धानान्येव तत् कल्पयन्ति॥
verses.tr: yadāvasathān kalpayanti sadohavirdhānānyeva tat kalpayanti
verses.en: When they arrange dwelling-rooms they arrange the sacred chamber and the shed for housing the Soma cars.

verses.sa: यदुपस्तृणन्ति बर्हिरेव तत्॥
verses.tr: yadupastṛṇanti barhireva tat
verses.en: What they spread upon the floor is just Sacrificial Grass.

verses.sa: यदुपरिशयनमाहरन्ति स्वर्गमेव तेन लोकमव रुन्द्धे॥
verses.tr: yadupariśayanamāharanti svargameva tena lokamava runddhe
verses.en: With the couch that the men bring, he wins for himself the world of Svarga.

verses.sa: यत् कशिपूपबर्हणमाहरन्ति परिधय एव ते॥
verses.tr: yat kaśipūpabarhaṇamāharanti paridhaya eva te
verses.en: The pillow-coverings that they bring are the green sticks that surround the sacrificial altar.

verses.sa: यदाञ्जनाभ्यञ्जनमाहरन्त्याज्यमेव तत्॥
verses.tr: yadāñjanābhyañjanamāharantyājyameva tat
verses.en: The ointment that they bring for injunction is just clarified liquid butter.

verses.sa: यत् पुरा परिवेषात् स्वादमाहरन्ति पुरोडाशावेव तौ॥
verses.tr: yat purā pariveṣāt svādamāharanti puroḍāśāveva tau
verses.en: The food they bring before the general distribution represents the two sacrificial cakes of rice meal.

verses.sa: यदशनकृतं ह्वयन्ति हविष्कृतमेव तद्ध्वयन्ति॥
verses.tr: yadaśanakṛtaṃ hvayanti haviṣkṛtameva taddhvayanti
verses.en: When they call the man who prepares food they summon the preparer of oblation.

verses.sa: ये व्रीहयो यवा निरुप्यन्तेंऽशव एव ते॥
verses.tr: ye vrīhayo yavā nirupyanteṃ'śava eva te
verses.en: The grains of rice and barley that are selected are just filaments of the Soma plant.

verses.sa: यान्युलूखलमुसलानि ग्रावाण एव ते॥
verses.tr: yānyulūkhalamusalāni grāvāṇa eva te
verses.en: The pestle and mortar are really the stones of the Soma press.

verses.sa: शूर्पं पवित्रं तुषा ऋजीषाभिषवणीरापः॥
verses.tr: śūrpaṃ pavitraṃ tuṣā ṛjīṣābhiṣavaṇīrāpaḥ
verses.en: The winnowing-basket is the filter, the chaff the Soma dregs, the water the pressing-gear.

verses.sa: स्रुग् दर्विर्नेक्षणमायवनं द्रोणकलशाः कुम्भ्योऽ वायव्याऽनि पात्राणीयमेव कृष्णाजिनम्॥
verses.tr: srug darvirnekṣaṇamāyavanaṃ droṇakalaśāḥ kumbhyo' vāyavyā'ni pātrāṇīyameva kṛṣṇājinam
verses.en: Spoon, ladle, fork, stirring-prong are the wooden Soma tubs; the earthen cooking-pots are the mortar-shaped Soma vessels; this earth is just the black -antelope's skin.

verses.sa:
(२)
१८-३० (१-१३) १ विराट् पुरस्ताद्बृहती, २, १२ साम्नी त्रिष्टुप्, ३ आसुरी अनुषटुप्, ४ साम्नी उष्णिक्,
५,११ साम्नी बृहती (११ भुरिक्) ६ आर्च्यनुष्टुप्, ७ त्रिपदा स्वराडनुष्टुप्, ८ आसुरी गायत्री,
९ साम्नी अनुष्टुप्, १० त्रिपदाऽर्ची त्रिष्टुप्, १३ त्रिपदाऽर्ची पङ्क्तिः (७ पञ्चपदा विराट् पुरस्ताद्बृहती, ८ साम्न्यनुष्टुप् वा)
यजमानब्राह्मणं वा एतदतिथिपतिः कुरुते यदाहार्याऽणि प्रेक्षत इदं भूया३ इदा३मिति ।१॥
verses.tr: (2) 18-30 (1-13) 1 virāṭ purastādbṛhatī, 2, 12 sāmnī triṣṭup, 3 āsurī anuṣaṭup, 4 sāmnī uṣṇik, 5,11 sāmnī bṛhatī (11 bhurik) 6 ārcyanuṣṭup, 7 tripadā svarāḍanuṣṭup, 8 āsurī gāyatrī, 9 sāmnī anuṣṭup, 10 tripadā'rcī triṣṭup, 13 tripadā'rcī paṅktiḥ (7 pañcapadā virāṭ purastādbṛhatī, 8 sāmnyanuṣṭup vā) yajamānabrāhmaṇaṃ vā etadatithipatiḥ kurute yadāhāryā'ṇi prekṣata idaṃ bhūyā3 idā3miti 1
verses.en: Or the host acts in this way to a Yajamana's Brahman: when he looks at the furniture and utensils he says, More here! Yet more here.

verses.sa: यदाह भूय उद्धरेति प्राणमेव तेन वर्षीयांसं कुरुते ।२॥
verses.tr: yadāha bhūya uddhareti prāṇameva tena varṣīyāṃsaṃ kurute 2
verses.en: When he says, Bring out more, he lengthens his life thereby.

verses.sa: उप हरति हवींष्या सादयति ।३॥
verses.tr: upa harati havīṃṣyā sādayati 3
verses.en: He brings oblations: he makes the men sit down.

verses.sa: तेषामासन्नानामतिथिरात्मन् जुहोति ।४॥
verses.tr: teṣāmāsannānāmatithirātman juhoti 4
verses.en: As the guest of the seated company he himself offers up sacrifice.

verses.sa: स्रुचा हस्तेन प्राणे यूपे स्रुक्कारेण वषट्कारेण ।५॥
verses.tr: srucā hastena prāṇe yūpe srukkāreṇa vaṣaṭkāreṇa 5
verses.en: With ladle, with hand, in life, at the sacrificial post, with cry of Ladle! with exclamation of Vashat!

verses.sa: एते वै प्रियाश्चाप्रियाश्चर्त्विजः स्वर्गं लोकं गमयन्ति यदतिथयः ।६॥
verses.tr: ete vai priyāścāpriyāścartvijaḥ svargaṃ lokaṃ gamayanti yadatithayaḥ 6
verses.en: Now these guests, as priests beloved or not beloved, bring one to the world of Svarga.

verses.sa: स य एवं विद्वान् न द्विषन्नश्नीयान्न द्विषतोऽन्नमश्नीयान्न मीमांसितस्य न मीमांसमानस्य ।७॥
verses.tr: sa ya evaṃ vidvān na dviṣannaśnīyānna dviṣato'nnamaśnīyānna mīmāṃsitasya na mīmāṃsamānasya 7
verses.en: He who hath this knowledge should not eat hating, should not eat the food of one who hates him, nor of one who is doubtful, nor of one who is undecided.

verses.sa: सर्वो वा एष जग्धपाप्मा यस्यान्नमश्नन्ति ।८॥
verses.tr: sarvo vā eṣa jagdhapāpmā yasyānnamaśnanti 8
verses.en: This man whose food they eat hath all his wickedness blotted out.

verses.sa: सर्वो वा एषोऽजग्धपाप्मा यस्यान्नं नाश्नन्ति ।९॥
verses.tr: sarvo vā eṣo'jagdhapāpmā yasyānnaṃ nāśnanti 9
verses.en: All that man's sin whose food they do not eat remains unblotted out.

verses.sa: सर्वदा वा एष युक्तग्रावार्द्रपवित्रो वितताध्वर आहृतयज्ञक्रतुर्य उपहरति ।१०॥
verses.tr: sarvadā vā eṣa yuktagrāvārdrapavitro vitatādhvara āhṛtayajñakraturya upaharati 10
verses.en: The man who supplies food hath always pressing stones adjusted, a wet Soma filter, well prepared religious rites, and mental power to complete the arranged sacrifice.

verses.sa: प्राजापत्यो वा एतस्य यज्ञो विततो य उपहरति ।११॥
verses.tr: prājāpatyo vā etasya yajño vitato ya upaharati 11
verses.en: The arranged sacrifice of the man who offers food is a sacrifice to Prajapati.

verses.sa: प्रजापतेर्वा एष विक्रमाननुविक्रमते य उपहरति ।१२॥
verses.tr: prajāpatervā eṣa vikramānanuvikramate ya upaharati 12
verses.en: The man who offers food follows the steps of Prajapati.

verses.sa: योऽतिथीनां स आहवनीयो यो वेश्मनि स गार्हपत्यो यस्मिन् पचन्ति स दक्षिणाग्निः।१३ ॥
verses.tr: yo'tithīnāṃ sa āhavanīyo yo veśmani sa gārhapatyo yasmin pacanti sa dakṣiṇāgniḥ13
verses.en: The fire of the guests is the Ahavaniya, the fire in the dwelling is the Garhapatya, that whereon they cook food is the Southern Sacrificial Fire.

verses.sa:
(३)
३१-३९ (१-९) १-६, ९ त्रिपदा पिपीलिकमध्या गायत्री, ७ साम्नी बृहती, ८ पिपीलिकमध्योष्णिक्।
इष्टं च वा एष पूर्तं च गृहाणामश्नाति यः पूर्वोऽतिथेरश्नाति ।१॥
verses.tr: (3) 31-39 (1-9) 1-6, 9 tripadā pipīlikamadhyā gāyatrī, 7 sāmnī bṛhatī, 8 pipīlikamadhyoṣṇik iṣṭaṃ ca vā eṣa pūrtaṃ ca gṛhāṇāmaśnāti yaḥ pūrvo'titheraśnāti 1
verses.en: Now that man who eats before the guest eats up the sacrifice and the merit of the house.

verses.sa: पयश्च वा एष रसं च गृहाणामश्नाति यः पूर्वोऽतिथेरश्नाति ।२॥
verses.tr: payaśca vā eṣa rasaṃ ca gṛhāṇāmaśnāti yaḥ pūrvo'titheraśnāti 2
verses.en: He devours the milk and the sap:

verses.sa: ऊर्जां च वा एष स्फातिं च गृहाणामश्नाति यः पूर्वोऽतिथेरश्नाति ।३॥
verses.tr: ūrjāṃ ca vā eṣa sphātiṃ ca gṛhāṇāmaśnāti yaḥ pūrvo'titheraśnāti 3
verses.en: And the vigour and prosperity:

verses.sa: प्रजां च वा एष पशूंश्च गृहाणामश्नाति यः पूर्वोऽतिथेरश्नाति ।४॥
verses.tr: prajāṃ ca vā eṣa paśūṃśca gṛhāṇāmaśnāti yaḥ pūrvo'titheraśnāti 4
verses.en: And the progeny and the cattle: t

verses.sa: कीर्तिं च वा एष यशश्च गृहाणामश्नाति यः पूर्वोऽतिथेरश्नाति ।५॥
verses.tr: kīrtiṃ ca vā eṣa yaśaśca gṛhāṇāmaśnāti yaḥ pūrvo'titheraśnāti 5
verses.en: And the fame and reputation.

verses.sa: श्रियं च वा एष संविदं च गृहाणामश्नाति यः पूर्वोऽतिथेरश्नाति ।६॥
verses.tr: śriyaṃ ca vā eṣa saṃvidaṃ ca gṛhāṇāmaśnāti yaḥ pūrvo'titheraśnāti 6
verses.en: The man who eats before the guest eats up the glory and the understanding of the house.

verses.sa: एष वा अतिथिर्यच्छ्रोत्रियस्तस्मात् पूर्वो नाश्नीयात् ।७॥
verses.tr: eṣa vā atithiryacchrotriyastasmāt pūrvo nāśnīyāt 7
verses.en: The man should not eat before the guest who is a Brahman versed in holy lore.

verses.sa: अशितावत्यतिथावश्नीयाद् यज्ञस्य सात्मत्वाय यज्ञस्याविच्छेदाय तद् व्रतम् ।८॥
verses.tr: aśitāvatyatithāvaśnīyād yajñasya sātmatvāya yajñasyāvicchedāya tad vratam 8
verses.en: When the guest hath eaten he should eat. This is the rule for the animation of the sacrifice and the preservation of its continuity.

verses.sa: एतद् वा उ स्वादीयो यदधिगवं क्षीरं वा मांसं वा तदेव नाश्नीयात् ।९॥
verses.tr: etad vā u svādīyo yadadhigavaṃ kṣīraṃ vā māṃsaṃ vā tadeva nāśnīyāt 9
verses.en: Now the sweetest portion, the produce of the cow, milk, or flesh, that verily he should not eat.

verses.sa:
(४)
४०-४४ (१-१०) १-४ प्राजापत्यानुष्टुप्, २-५ त्रिपदा गायत्री, ९ भुरिक्, १० चतुष्पदा प्रस्तारपङ्क्तिः।
स य एवं विद्वान् क्षीरमुपसिच्योपहरति ।१।
यावदग्निष्टोमेनेष्ट्वा सुसमृद्धेनावरुन्धे तावदेनेनाव रुन्धे ।२॥
verses.tr: (4) 40-44 (1-10) 1-4 prājāpatyānuṣṭup, 2-5 tripadā gāyatrī, 9 bhurik, 10 catuṣpadā prastārapaṅktiḥ sa ya evaṃ vidvān kṣīramupasicyopaharati 1 yāvadagniṣṭomeneṣṭvā susamṛddhenāvarundhe tāvadenenāva rundhe 2
verses.en: The man who having this knowledge pours out milk and offers it wins for himself as much thereby as he gains by the performance of a very successful Agnishtoma sacrifice.

verses.sa:
स य एवं विद्वान्त्सर्पिरुपसिच्योपहरति ।३।
यावदतिरात्रेणेष्ट्वा सुसमृद्धेनावरुन्धे तावदेनेनाव रुन्धे ।४॥
verses.tr: sa ya evaṃ vidvāntsarpirupasicyopaharati 3 yāvadatirātreṇeṣṭvā susamṛddhenāvarundhe tāvadenenāva rundhe 4
verses.en: The man who having this knowledge pours out clarified butter and offers it wins for himself thereby as much as he gains by the performance of a very successful Atiratra sacrifice.

verses.sa:
स य एवं विद्वान् मधूपसिच्योपहरति ।५।
यावत् सत्त्रसद्येनेष्ट्वा सुसमृद्धेनावरुन्धे तावदेनेनाव रुन्धे ।६॥
verses.tr: sa ya evaṃ vidvān madhūpasicyopaharati 5 yāvat sattrasadyeneṣṭvā susamṛddhenāvarundhe tāvadenenāva rundhe 6
verses.en: He who pours out mead and offers it wins for himself thereby as much as he gains by the performance of a very successful Sattrasadya sacrifice,

verses.sa:
स य एवं विद्वान् मांसमुपसिच्योपहरति ।७।
यावद् द्वादशाहेनेष्ट्वा सुसमृद्धेनावरुन्धे तावदेनेनाव रुन्धे ।८॥
verses.tr: sa ya evaṃ vidvān māṃsamupasicyopaharati 7 yāvad dvādaśāheneṣṭvā susamṛddhenāvarundhe tāvadenenāva rundhe 8
verses.en: He who having this knowledge besprinkles flesh and offers it wins for himself thereby as much as he-gains by the performance of a very successful Twelve-day sacrifice.

verses.sa:
स य एवं विद्वानुदकमुपसिच्योपहरति ।९।
प्रजानां प्रजननाय गच्छति प्रतिष्ठां प्रियः प्रजानां भवति य एवं विद्वानुदकमुपसिच्योपहरति ।१०॥
verses.tr: sa ya evaṃ vidvānudakamupasicyopaharati 9 prajānāṃ prajananāya gacchati pratiṣṭhāṃ priyaḥ prajānāṃ bhavati ya evaṃ vidvānudakamupasicyopaharati 10
verses.en: The man who having this knowledge pours out water and offers it obtains a resting place for the procreation of living beings and becomes dear to living beings, even the man who having this knowledge pours out water and offers it.

verses.sa:
(५)
४५-४८ (१-१०) १ साम्नी उष्णिक्, २ पुर उष्णिक्, ३ साम्नी भुरिग्बृहती, ४ ६, ९ साम्नी अनुष्टुप्,
५ त्रिपदा निचृद्विषमा नाम गायत्री, ७ त्रिपदा विराड् विषमा नाम गायत्री, ८ त्रिपदा विराडनुष्टुप्।
तस्मा उषा हिङ्कृणोति सविता प्र स्तौति ।१।
बृहस्पतिरूर्जयोद्गायति त्वष्टा पुष्ट्या प्रति हरति विश्वे देवा निधनम्।२।
निधनं भूत्याः प्रजायाः पशूनां भवति य एवं वेद ।३॥
verses.tr: (5) 45-48 (1-10) 1 sāmnī uṣṇik, 2 pura uṣṇik, 3 sāmnī bhurigbṛhatī, 4 6, 9 sāmnī anuṣṭup, 5 tripadā nicṛdviṣamā nāma gāyatrī, 7 tripadā virāḍ viṣamā nāma gāyatrī, 8 tripadā virāḍanuṣṭup tasmā uṣā hiṅkṛṇoti savitā pra stauti 1 bṛhaspatirūrjayodgāyati tvaṣṭā puṣṭyā prati harati viśve devā nidhanam2 nidhanaṃ bhūtyāḥ prajāyāḥ paśūnāṃ bhavati ya evaṃ veda 3
verses.en: For him Dawn murmurs, and Savitar sings the prelude; Brihaspati chants with vigour, and Tvasbtar Joins in with increase; the Visve Devah take up the conclusion. He who hath this knowledge is the abiding-place of welfare, of progeny, and of cattle.

verses.sa:
तस्मा उद्यन्त्सूर्यो हिङ्कृणोति संगवः प्र स्तौति ।४।
मध्यन्दिन उद्गायत्यपराह्णः प्रति हरत्यस्तंयन् निधनम्।
निधनं भूत्याः प्रजायाः पशूनां भवति य एवं वेद ।५॥
verses.tr: tasmā udyantsūryo hiṅkṛṇoti saṃgavaḥ pra stauti 4 madhyandina udgāyatyaparāhṇaḥ prati haratyastaṃyan nidhanam nidhanaṃ bhūtyāḥ prajāyāḥ paśūnāṃ bhavati ya evaṃ veda 5
verses.en: For him the rising Sun murmurs, and Early Morning sings the prelude; Noon chants the psalm, Afternoon joins in; the setting Sun takes up the conclusion. He who hath this knowledge is the abiding: place of welfare, of progeny, and of cattle.'

verses.sa:
तस्मा अभ्रो भवन् हिङ्कृणोति स्तनयन् प्र स्तौति ।६।
विद्योतमानः प्रति हरति वर्षन्नुद्गायत्युद्गृह्णन् निधनम्।
निधनं भूत्याः प्रजायाः पशूनां भवति य एवं वेद ।७।
अतिथीन् प्रति पश्यति हिङ्कृणोत्यभि वदति प्र स्तौत्युदकं याचत्युद्गायति ।८॥
verses.tr: tasmā abhro bhavan hiṅkṛṇoti stanayan pra stauti 6 vidyotamānaḥ prati harati varṣannudgāyatyudgṛhṇan nidhanam nidhanaṃ bhūtyāḥ prajāyāḥ paśūnāṃ bhavati ya evaṃ veda 7 atithīn prati paśyati hiṅkṛṇotyabhi vadati pra stautyudakaṃ yācatyudgāyati 8
verses.en: For him the Rain-cloud murmurs when present, sings the prelude when thundering, joins in when lightening, chants the psalm when raining, and takes up the conclusion when it stays the downpour. He who hath this knowledge is the abiding-place of welfare, of progeny, and of cattle.

verses.sa:
उप हरति प्रति हरत्युच्छिष्टं निधनम्।९।
निधनं भूत्याः प्रजायाः पशूनां भवति य एवं वेद ।१०॥
verses.tr: upa harati prati haratyucchiṣṭaṃ nidhanam9 nidhanaṃ bhūtyāḥ prajāyāḥ paśūnāṃ bhavati ya evaṃ veda 10
verses.en: He looks at 'the guests, he utters a gentle sound; he speaks, he sings the prelude; he calls for water, he chants the psalm; he offers the residue of the sacrifice, he takes up the conclusion.

verses.sa:
(६)
४९-६२ (१-१४) १ आसुरी गायत्री, २ साम्नी अनुष्टुप्, ३,५ त्रिपदार्ची पङ्क्तिः, ४ एकपदा प्राजापत्या गायत्री,
६-११ आर्ची बृहती, १२ एकपदाऽऽसुरी जगती, १३ याजुषी त्रिष्टुप्, १४ एकपदाऽऽसुरी उष्णिक्।
यत् क्षत्तारं ह्वयत्या श्रावयत्येव तत् ।१॥
verses.tr: (6) 49-62 (1-14) 1 āsurī gāyatrī, 2 sāmnī anuṣṭup, 3,5 tripadārcī paṅktiḥ, 4 ekapadā prājāpatyā gāyatrī, 6-11 ārcī bṛhatī, 12 ekapadā''surī jagatī, 13 yājuṣī triṣṭup, 14 ekapadā''surī uṣṇik yat kṣattāraṃ hvayatyā śrāvayatyeva tat 1
verses.en: When he summons the door-keeper he gives instruction.

verses.sa: यत् प्रतिशृणोति प्रत्याश्रावयत्येव तत् ।२॥
verses.tr: yat pratiśṛṇoti pratyāśrāvayatyeva tat 2
verses.en: He (the door-keeper) pronounces the sacrificial formula in his answer to what he hears.

verses.sa: यत् परिवेष्टारः पात्रहस्ताः पूर्वे चापरे च प्रपद्यन्ते चमसाध्वर्यव एव ते ।३॥
verses.tr: yat pariveṣṭāraḥ pātrahastāḥ pūrve cāpare ca prapadyante camasādhvaryava eva te 3
verses.en: When the attendants with vessels in their hands, foremost and hindmost, come in, they are just the priests who manage the Soma cup.

verses.sa: तेषां न कश्चनाहोता ।४॥
verses.tr: teṣāṃ na kaścanāhotā 4
verses.en: Not one of them is incompetent to sacrifice.

verses.sa: यद् वा अतिथिपतिरतिथीन् परिविष्य गृहानुपोदैत्यवभृथमेव तदुपावैति ।५॥
verses.tr: yad vā atithipatiratithīn pariviṣya gṛhānupodaityavabhṛthameva tadupāvaiti 5
verses.en: Or if the host, having offered food to his guest, goes up to the house, he virtually enters the bath of purification.

verses.sa: यत् सभागयति दक्षिणाः सभागयति यदनुतिष्ठत उदवस्यत्येव तत् ।६॥
verses.tr: yat sabhāgayati dakṣiṇāḥ sabhāgayati yadanutiṣṭhata udavasyatyeva tat 6
verses.en: When he distributes food he distributes priestly fees; what he performs he asks as favour.

verses.sa: स उपहूतः पृथिव्यां भक्षयत्युपहूतस्तस्मिन् यत् पृथिव्यां विश्वरूपम् ।७॥
verses.tr: sa upahūtaḥ pṛthivyāṃ bhakṣayatyupahūtastasmin yat pṛthivyāṃ viśvarūpam 7
verses.en: He, having been invited on earth, regales, invited, in that which wears all various forms on earth.

verses.sa: स उपहूतोऽन्तरिक्षे भक्षयत्युपहूतस्तस्मिन् यदन्तरिक्षे विश्वरूपम् ।८॥
verses.tr: sa upahūto'ntarikṣe bhakṣayatyupahūtastasmin yadantarikṣe viśvarūpam 8
verses.en: He, having been invited in air, regales, invited, in that which wears all various forms in air.

verses.sa: स उपहूतो दिवि भक्षयत्युपहूतस्तस्मिन् यद् दिवि विश्वरूपम् ।९॥
verses.tr: sa upahūto divi bhakṣayatyupahūtastasmin yad divi viśvarūpam 9
verses.en: He having been invited in the sky, regales, invited, in that which wears all various forms in the sky.

verses.sa: स उपहूतो देवेषु भक्षयत्युपहूतस्तस्मिन् यद् देवेषु विश्वरूपम् ।१०॥
verses.tr: sa upahūto deveṣu bhakṣayatyupahūtastasmin yad deveṣu viśvarūpam 10
verses.en: He, having been invited among the Gods, regales, invited, in that which wears all various forms among the Gods.

verses.sa: स उपहूतो लोकेषु भक्षयत्युपहूतस्तस्मिन्य यल्लोकेषु विश्वरूपम् ।११॥
verses.tr: sa upahūto lokeṣu bhakṣayatyupahūtastasminya yallokeṣu viśvarūpam 11
verses.en: He, having been invited in the worlds, regales, invited, in that which wears all various forms in the worlds.

verses.sa: स उपहूत उपहूतः ।१२॥
verses.tr: sa upahūta upahūtaḥ 12
verses.en: He, having been invited, hath been invited.

verses.sa: आप्नोतीमं लोकमाप्नोत्यमुम् ।१३॥
verses.tr: āpnotīmaṃ lokamāpnotyamum 13
verses.en: He gains this world and the world yonder.

verses.sa: ज्योतिष्मतो लोकान् जयति य एवं वेद ।१४॥
verses.tr: jyotiṣmato lokān jayati ya evaṃ veda 14
verses.en: He who hath this knowledge wins the luminous spheres.

sections.label: A glorification of the typical bull and cow
sections.name: Book 9, hymn 7

verses.sa: प्रजापतिश्च परमेष्ठी च शृङ्गे इन्द्रः शिरो अग्निर्ललाटं यमः कृकाटम्॥
verses.tr: prajāpatiśca parameṣṭhī ca śṛṅge indraḥ śiro agnirlalāṭaṃ yamaḥ kṛkāṭam
verses.en: Prajapati and Parameshthin are the two horns, Indra is the head, Agni the forehead, Yama the joint of the neck.

verses.sa: सोमो राजा मस्तिष्को द्यौरुत्तरहनुः पृथिव्यऽधरहनुः॥
verses.tr: somo rājā mastiṣko dyauruttarahanuḥ pṛthivya'dharahanuḥ
verses.en: King Soma is the brain, Sky is the upper jaw, Earth is the lower jaw.

verses.sa: विद्युज्जिह्वा मरुतो दन्ता रेवतिर्ग्रीवाः कृत्तिका स्कन्धा घर्मो वहः॥
verses.tr: vidyujjihvā maruto dantā revatirgrīvāḥ kṛttikā skandhā gharmo vahaḥ
verses.en: Lightning is the tongue, the Maruts are the teeth, Revati is the neck, the Krittikas are the shoulders, the Gharma is the shoulder-bar.

verses.sa: विश्वं वायुः स्वर्गो लोकः कृष्णद्रं विधरणी निवेष्यः॥
verses.tr: viśvaṃ vāyuḥ svargo lokaḥ kṛṣṇadraṃ vidharaṇī niveṣyaḥ
verses.en: His universe is Vayu, Svarga is his world, Krishnadram is the tendons and vertebrae.

verses.sa: श्येनः क्रोडो३ऽन्तरिक्षं पाजस्यं१ बृहस्पतिः ककुद् बृहतीः कीकसाः॥
verses.tr: śyenaḥ kroḍo3'ntarikṣaṃ pājasyaṃ1 bṛhaspatiḥ kakud bṛhatīḥ kīkasāḥ
verses.en: The Syena ceremony is the breast, Air is the region of the belly, Brihaspati is the hump, Brihati the breast-bone and cartilages of the ribs.

verses.sa: देवानां पत्नीः पृष्टय उपसदः पर्शवः॥
verses.tr: devānāṃ patnīḥ pṛṣṭaya upasadaḥ parśavaḥ
verses.en: The consorts of the Gods are the ribs, the attendants are ribs.

verses.sa: मित्रश्च वरुणश्चांसौ त्वष्टा चार्यमा च दोषणी महादेवो बाहू॥
verses.tr: mitraśca varuṇaścāṃsau tvaṣṭā cāryamā ca doṣaṇī mahādevo bāhū
verses.en: Mitra and Varuna are the shoulder-blades, Tvashtar and Aryaman the fore-arms, Mahadeva is the arms.

verses.sa: इन्द्राणी भसद् वायुः पुच्छं पवमानो बालाः॥
verses.tr: indrāṇī bhasad vāyuḥ pucchaṃ pavamāno bālāḥ
verses.en: Indrani is the hinder parts, Vayu the tail, Pavamana the hair.

verses.sa: ब्रह्म च क्षत्रं च श्रोणी बलमूरू॥
verses.tr: brahma ca kṣatraṃ ca śroṇī balamūrū
verses.en: Priestly rank and princely power are the hips, and strength is the thigh.

verses.sa: धाता च सविता चाष्ठीवन्तौ जङ्घा गन्धर्वा अप्सरसः कुष्ठिका अदितिः शफाः॥
verses.tr: dhātā ca savitā cāṣṭhīvantau jaṅghā gandharvā apsarasaḥ kuṣṭhikā aditiḥ śaphāḥ
verses.en: Dhatar and Savitar are the two knee-bones, the Gandharvas are the legs, the Apsarases are bits of the feet, Aditi is the hooves.

verses.sa: चेतो हृदयं यकृन्मेधा व्रतं पुरीतत्॥
verses.tr: ceto hṛdayaṃ yakṛnmedhā vrataṃ purītat
verses.en: Thought is the heart, intelligence is the liver, law the pericardium.

verses.sa: क्षुत् कुक्षिरिरा वनिष्ठुः पर्वताः प्लाशयः॥
verses.tr: kṣut kukṣirirā vaniṣṭhuḥ parvatāḥ plāśayaḥ
verses.en: Hunger is the belly, refreshing drink is the rectum, mountains are the inward parts.

verses.sa: क्रोधो वृक्कौ मन्युराण्डौ प्रजा शेपः॥
verses.tr: krodho vṛkkau manyurāṇḍau prajā śepaḥ
verses.en: Wrath is the kidneys, anger the testes, offspring the generative organ.

verses.sa: नदी सूत्री वर्षस्य पतय स्तना स्तनयित्नुरूधः॥
verses.tr: nadī sūtrī varṣasya pataya stanā stanayitnurūdhaḥ
verses.en: The river is the womb, the Lords of the Rain are the breasts, the thunder is the udder.

verses.sa: विश्वव्यचास्चर्मौषधयो लोमानि नक्षत्राणि रूपम्॥
verses.tr: viśvavyacāscarmauṣadhayo lomāni nakṣatrāṇi rūpam
verses.en: The All-embracing (Aditi) is the hide, the herbs are her hair, and the Lunar Mansions her form.

verses.sa: देवजना गुदा मनुष्याऽ आन्त्राण्यत्रा उदरम्॥
verses.tr: devajanā gudā manuṣyā' āntrāṇyatrā udaram
verses.en: The hosts of Gods are her entrails, men are her bowels, and demons her abdomen.

verses.sa: रक्षांसि लोहितमितरजना ऊबध्यम्॥
verses.tr: rakṣāṃsi lohitamitarajanā ūbadhyam
verses.en: Rakshasas are the blood, the Other Folk are the contents of the stomach.

verses.sa: अभ्रं पीबो मज्जा निधनम्॥
verses.tr: abhraṃ pībo majjā nidhanam
verses.en: The rain-cloud is her fat, her resting-place her marrow.

verses.sa: अग्निरासीन उत्थितोऽश्विना॥
verses.tr: agnirāsīna utthito'śvinā
verses.en: Sitting he is Agni, when he hath stood up he is the Asvins.

verses.sa: इन्द्रः प्राङ् तिष्ठन् दक्षिणा तिष्ठन् यमः॥
verses.tr: indraḥ prāṅ tiṣṭhan dakṣiṇā tiṣṭhan yamaḥ
verses.en: Standing eastwards he is Indra, standing southwards, Yama.

verses.sa: प्रत्यङ् तिष्ठन् धातोदङ् तिष्ठन्त्सविता॥
verses.tr: pratyaṅ tiṣṭhan dhātodaṅ tiṣṭhantsavitā
verses.en: Standing westwards he is Dhatar, standing northwards Savitar.

verses.sa: तृणानि प्राप्तः सोमो राजा॥
verses.tr: tṛṇāni prāptaḥ somo rājā
verses.en: When he hath got his grass he is King Soma.

verses.sa: मित्र ईक्षमाण आवृत्त आनन्दः॥
verses.tr: mitra īkṣamāṇa āvṛtta ānandaḥ
verses.en: He is Mitra when he looks about him, and when he hath turned round he is joy.

verses.sa: युज्यमानो वैश्वदेवो युक्तः प्रजापतिर्विमुक्तः सर्वम्॥
verses.tr: yujyamāno vaiśvadevo yuktaḥ prajāpatirvimuktaḥ sarvam
verses.en: When he is yoking he belongs to the All-gods, when yoked he is Prajapati, when unyoked he is All.

verses.sa: एतद् वै विश्वरूपं सर्वरूपं गोरूपम्॥
verses.tr: etad vai viśvarūpaṃ sarvarūpaṃ gorūpam
verses.en: This verily is omniform, wearing all forms, bovine-formed.

verses.sa: उपैनं विश्वरूपाः सर्वरूपाः पशवस्तिष्ठन्ति य एवं वेद॥
verses.tr: upainaṃ viśvarūpāḥ sarvarūpāḥ paśavastiṣṭhanti ya evaṃ veda
verses.en: Upon him wait omniform beasts, wearing every shape, each one who hath this knowledge.

sections.label: A charm for the cure of various diseases connected with Consumption
sections.name: Book 9, hymn 8

verses.sa:
शीर्षक्तिं शीर्षामयं कर्णशूलं विलोहितम्।
सर्वं शीर्षण्यंऽ ते रोगं बहिर्निर्मन्त्रयामहे॥
verses.tr: śīrṣaktiṃ śīrṣāmayaṃ karṇaśūlaṃ vilohitam sarvaṃ śīrṣaṇyaṃ' te rogaṃ bahirnirmantrayāmahe
verses.en: Each pain and ache that racks the head, earache, and erysipelas, All malady that wrings thy brow we charm away with this our spell.

verses.sa:
कर्णाभ्यां ते कङ्कूषेभ्यः कर्णशूलं विसल्पकम्।
सर्वं शीर्षण्यंऽ ते रोगं बहिर्निर्मन्त्रयामहे॥
verses.tr: karṇābhyāṃ te kaṅkūṣebhyaḥ karṇaśūlaṃ visalpakam sarvaṃ śīrṣaṇyaṃ' te rogaṃ bahirnirmantrayāmahe
verses.en: From both thine ears, from parts thereof, thine ear-ache, and the throbbing pain, All malady that wrings thy brow we charm away with this our spell.

verses.sa:
यस्य हेतोः प्रच्यवते यक्ष्मः कर्णत आस्यतः ।
सर्वं शीर्षण्यंऽ ते रोगं बहिर्निर्मन्त्रयामहे॥
verses.tr: yasya hetoḥ pracyavate yakṣmaḥ karṇata āsyataḥ sarvaṃ śīrṣaṇyaṃ' te rogaṃ bahirnirmantrayāmahe
verses.en: So that Consumption may depart forth from thine ears and from thy mouth, l All malady that wrings thy brow we charm away with this our spell.

verses.sa:
यः कृणोति प्रमोतमन्धं कृणोति पूरुषम्।
सर्वं शीर्षण्यंऽ ते रोगं बहिर्निर्मन्त्रयामहे॥
verses.tr: yaḥ kṛṇoti pramotamandhaṃ kṛṇoti pūruṣam sarvaṃ śīrṣaṇyaṃ' te rogaṃ bahirnirmantrayāmahe
verses.en: The malady that makes one deaf; the malady that makes one blind, All malady that wrings thy brow we charm away with this our spell.

verses.sa:
अङ्गभेदमङ्गज्वरं विश्वाङ्ग्यंऽ विसल्पकम्।
सर्वं शीर्षण्यंऽ ते रोगं बहिर्निर्मन्त्रयामहे॥
verses.tr: aṅgabhedamaṅgajvaraṃ viśvāṅgyaṃ' visalpakam sarvaṃ śīrṣaṇyaṃ' te rogaṃ bahirnirmantrayāmahe
verses.en: The throbbing pain in all thy limbs that rends thy frame with fever-throes, All malady that wrings thy brow we charm away with this our spell.

verses.sa:
यस्य भीमः प्रतीकाश उद्वेपयति पूरुषम्।
तक्मानं विश्वशारदं बहिर्निर्मन्त्रयामहे॥
verses.tr: yasya bhīmaḥ pratīkāśa udvepayati pūruṣam takmānaṃ viśvaśāradaṃ bahirnirmantrayāmahe
verses.en: The malady whose awful look makes a man quiver with alarm, Fever whom every Autumn brings we charm away with this our spell.

verses.sa:
य ऊरू अनुसर्पत्यथो एति गवीनिके ।
यक्ष्मं ते अन्तरङ्गेभ्यो बहिर्निर्मन्त्रयामहे॥
verses.tr: ya ūrū anusarpatyatho eti gavīnike yakṣmaṃ te antaraṅgebhyo bahirnirmantrayāmahe
verses.en: Disease that creeps about the thighs and, after, reaches both the groins, Consumption from thine inward parts we charm away with this our spell.

verses.sa:
यदि कामादपकामाद्धृदयाज्जायते परि ।
हृदो बलासमङ्गेभ्यो बहिर्निर्मन्त्रयामहे॥
verses.tr: yadi kāmādapakāmāddhṛdayājjāyate pari hṛdo balāsamaṅgebhyo bahirnirmantrayāmahe
verses.en: If the disease originates from love, from hatred, from the heart, Forth from the heart and from the limbs we charm the wasting malady.

verses.sa:
हरिमाणं ते अङ्गेभ्योऽप्वामन्तरोदरात्।
यक्ष्मोधामन्तरात्मनो बहिर्निर्मन्त्रयामहे॥
verses.tr: harimāṇaṃ te aṅgebhyo'pvāmantarodarāt yakṣmodhāmantarātmano bahirnirmantrayāmahe
verses.en: The yellow Jaundice from thy limbs, and Colic from the parts within, And Phthisis from thine inward soul we charm away with this our spell.

verses.sa:
आसो बलासो भवतु मूत्रं भवत्वामयत्।
यक्ष्माणां सर्वेषां विषं निरवोचमहं त्वत्॥
verses.tr: āso balāso bhavatu mūtraṃ bhavatvāmayat yakṣmāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ viṣaṃ niravocamahaṃ tvat
verses.en: Let wasting malady turn to dust, become the water of disease. I have evoked the poison-taint of all Consumptions out of thee.

verses.sa:
बहिर्बिलं निर्द्रवतु काहाबाहं तवोदरात्।
यक्ष्माणां सर्वेषां विषं निरवोचमहं त्वत्॥
verses.tr: bahirbilaṃ nirdravatu kāhābāhaṃ tavodarāt yakṣmāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ viṣaṃ niravocamahaṃ tvat
verses.en: Forth from the hollow let it run, and rumbling sounds from thine inside. I have evoked the poison-taint of all Consumptions out of thee.

verses.sa:
उदरात् ते क्लोम्नो नाभ्या हृदयादधि ।
यक्ष्माणां सर्वेषां विषं निरवोचमहं त्वत्॥
verses.tr: udarāt te klomno nābhyā hṛdayādadhi yakṣmāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ viṣaṃ niravocamahaṃ tvat
verses.en: Forth from thy belly and thy lungs, forth from thy navel and thy heart I have evoked the poison-taint of all Consumptions out of thee.

verses.sa:
याः सीमानं विरुजन्ति मूर्धानं प्रत्यर्षनीः ।
अहिंसन्तीरनामया निर्द्रवन्तु बहिर्बिलम्॥
verses.tr: yāḥ sīmānaṃ virujanti mūrdhānaṃ pratyarṣanīḥ ahiṃsantīranāmayā nirdravantu bahirbilam
verses.en: The penetrating stabs of pain which rend asunder crown and head, Let them depart and pass away, free from disease and harming not.

verses.sa:
या हृदयमुपर्षन्त्यनुतन्वन्ति कीकसाः ।
अहिंसन्तीरनामया निर्द्रवन्तु बहिर्बिलम्॥
verses.tr: yā hṛdayamuparṣantyanutanvanti kīkasāḥ ahiṃsantīranāmayā nirdravantu bahirbilam
verses.en: The pangs that stab the heart and reach the breast-bone and connected parts, Let them depart and pass away, free from disease and harming not.

verses.sa:
