याः पार्श्वे उपर्षन्त्यनुनिक्षन्ति पृष्टीः ।
अहिंसन्तीरनामया निर्द्रवन्तु बहिर्बिलम्॥
verses.tr: yāḥ pārśve uparṣantyanunikṣanti pṛṣṭīḥ ahiṃsantīranāmayā nirdravantu bahirbilam
verses.en: The stabs that penetrate the sides and pierce their way along the ribs, Let them depart and pass away, free from disease and harming not.

verses.sa:
यास्तिरश्चीरुपर्षन्त्यर्षणीर्वक्षणासु ते ।
अहिंसन्तीरनामया निर्द्रवन्तु बहिर्बिलम्॥
verses.tr: yāstiraścīruparṣantyarṣaṇīrvakṣaṇāsu te ahiṃsantīranāmayā nirdravantu bahirbilam
verses.en: The penetrating pangs that pierce thy stomach as they shoot across, Let them depart and pass away, free from disease and harming not.

verses.sa:
या गुदा अनुसर्पन्त्यान्त्राणि मोहयन्ति च ।
अहिंसन्तीरनामया निर्द्रवन्तु बहिर्बिलम्॥
verses.tr: yā gudā anusarpantyāntrāṇi mohayanti ca ahiṃsantīranāmayā nirdravantu bahirbilam
verses.en: The pains that through the bowels creep, disorder-ing the inward parts, Let them depart and pass away, free from disease and harming not.

verses.sa:
या मज्ज्ञो निर्धयन्ति परूंषि विरुजन्ति च ।
अहिंसन्तीरनामया निर्द्रवन्तु बहिर्बिलम्॥
verses.tr: yā majjño nirdhayanti parūṃṣi virujanti ca ahiṃsantīranāmayā nirdravantu bahirbilam
verses.en: The pains that suck the marrow out, and rend and tear the bones apart, May they speed forth and pass away, free from disease and harming not.

verses.sa:
ये अङ्गानि मदयन्ति यक्ष्मासो रोपणास्तव ।
यक्ष्माणां सर्वेषां विषं निरवोचमहं त्वत्॥
verses.tr: ye aṅgāni madayanti yakṣmāso ropaṇāstava yakṣmāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ viṣaṃ niravocamahaṃ tvat
verses.en: Consumptions with their Colic pains which make thy limbs insensible—I have evoked the poison-taint of all Consumptions out of thee.

verses.sa:
विसल्पस्य विद्रधस्य वातीकारस्य वालजेः ।
यक्ष्माणां सर्वेषां विषं निरवोचमहं त्वत्॥
verses.tr: visalpasya vidradhasya vātīkārasya vālajeḥ yakṣmāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ viṣaṃ niravocamahaṃ tvat
verses.en: Of piercing pain, of abscesses, rheumatic ache, ophthalmia—I have evoked the poison-taint of all Consumptions out of thee.

verses.sa:
पादाभ्यां ते जानुभ्यां श्रोणिभ्यां परि भंससः ।
अनूकादर्षणीरुष्णिहाभ्यः शीर्ष्णो रोगमनीनशम्॥
verses.tr: pādābhyāṃ te jānubhyāṃ śroṇibhyāṃ pari bhaṃsasaḥ anūkādarṣaṇīruṣṇihābhyaḥ śīrṣṇo rogamanīnaśam
verses.en: I have dispelled the piercing pains from feet, knees, hips, and hinder parts, And spine, and from the neck and nape the malady that racked the head.

verses.sa:
सं ते शीर्ष्णः कपालानि हृदयस्य च यो विधुः ।
उद्यन्नादित्य रश्मिभिः शीर्ष्णो रोगमनीनशोऽङ्गभेदमशीशमः॥
verses.tr: saṃ te śīrṣṇaḥ kapālāni hṛdayasya ca yo vidhuḥ udyannāditya raśmibhiḥ śīrṣṇo rogamanīnaśo'ṅgabhedamaśīśamaḥ
verses.en: Sound are the skull-bones of thy head and thy heart's bent is regular. Thou, Sun, arising with thy beams hast chased away the head's disease, hast stilled the pain that racked the limbs.

sections.label: Enunciation of mystico-theological and cosmological doctrine
sections.name: Book 9, hymn 9

verses.sa:
अस्य वामस्य पलितस्य होतुस्तस्य भ्राता मध्यमो अस्त्यश्नः ।
तृतीयो भ्राता घृतपृष्ठो अस्यात्रापश्यं विश्पतिं सप्तपुत्रम्॥
verses.tr: asya vāmasya palitasya hotustasya bhrātā madhyamo astyaśnaḥ tṛtīyo bhrātā ghṛtapṛṣṭho asyātrāpaśyaṃ viśpatiṃ saptaputram
verses.en: The second brother of this lovely Hotar, hoary with eld, is the voracious Lightning. The third is he whose back is balmed with butter. Here have I seen the King with seven male children.

verses.sa:
सप्त युञ्जन्ति रथमेकचक्रमेको अश्वो वहति सप्तनामा ।
त्रिनाभि चक्रमजरमनर्वं यत्रेमा विश्वा भुवनाधि तस्थुः॥
verses.tr: sapta yuñjanti rathamekacakrameko aśvo vahati saptanāmā trinābhi cakramajaramanarvaṃ yatremā viśvā bhuvanādhi tasthuḥ
verses.en: The seven make the one-wheeled chariot ready: bearing seven names the single Courser draws it. The wheel, three-naved, is sound and undecaying: thereon these worlds of life are all dependent.

verses.sa:
इमं रथमधि ये सप्त तस्थुः सप्तचक्रं सप्त वहन्त्यश्वाः ।
सप्त स्वसारो अभि सं नवन्त यत्र गवां निहिता सप्त नामा॥
verses.tr: imaṃ rathamadhi ye sapta tasthuḥ saptacakraṃ sapta vahantyaśvāḥ sapta svasāro abhi saṃ navanta yatra gavāṃ nihitā sapta nāmā
verses.en: The seven who on this seven-wheeled car are mounted have horses, seven in tale, who draw them onward. Seven sisters utter songs of praise together, in whom the Cows' seven names are held and treasured.

verses.sa:
को ददर्श प्रथमं जायमानमस्थन्वन्तं यदनस्था बिभर्ति ।
भूम्या असुरसृगात्मा क्वऽस्वित् को विद्वांसमुप गात् प्रष्टुमेतत्॥
verses.tr: ko dadarśa prathamaṃ jāyamānamasthanvantaṃ yadanasthā bibharti bhūmyā asurasṛgātmā kva'svit ko vidvāṃsamupa gāt praṣṭumetat
verses.en: Who hath beheld at birth the Primal Being, when She who hath no bone supports the bony? Where is the blood of earth, the life, the spirit? Who may approach the man who knows, to ask it?

verses.sa:
इह ब्रवीतु य ईमङ्ग वेदास्य वामस्य निहितं पदं वेः ।
शीर्ष्णः क्षीरं दुह्रते गावो अस्य वव्रिं वसाना उदकं पदापुः॥
verses.tr: iha bravītu ya īmaṅga vedāsya vāmasya nihitaṃ padaṃ veḥ śīrṣṇaḥ kṣīraṃ duhrate gāvo asya vavriṃ vasānā udakaṃ padāpuḥ
verses.en: Let him who knoweth presently declare it, this lovely Bird's securely-founded station. Forth from his head the Cows draw milk, and wearing his vesture with their foot have drunk the water.

verses.sa:
पाकः पृच्छामि मनसाविजानन् देवानामेना निहिता पदानि ।
वत्से बष्कयेऽधि सप्त तन्तून् वि तत्निरे कवय ओतवा उ॥
verses.tr: pākaḥ pṛcchāmi manasāvijānan devānāmenā nihitā padāni vatse baṣkaye'dhi sapta tantūn vi tatnire kavaya otavā u
verses.en: Unripe in mind, in spirit undiscerning, I ask of these the Gods' established places. High up above the yearling Calf the sages, to form a web, their own seven threads have woven.

verses.sa:
अचिकित्वांस्चिकितुषश्चिदत्र कवीन् पृच्छामि विद्वनो न विद्वान्।
वि यस्तस्तम्भ षडिमा रजांस्यजस्य रूपे किमपि स्विदेकम्॥
verses.tr: acikitvāṃscikituṣaścidatra kavīn pṛcchāmi vidvano na vidvān vi yastastambha ṣaḍimā rajāṃsyajasya rūpe kimapi svidekam
verses.en: Here, ignorant, I ask the wise who know it, as one who knows not, for the sake of knowledge, What is That One, who in the Unborn's image hath stablished and fixed firm this world's six region.

verses.sa:
माता पितरमृत आ बभाज धीत्यग्रे मनसा सं हि जग्मे।
सा बीभत्सुर्गर्भरसा निविद्धा नमस्वन्त इदुपवाकमीयुः॥
verses.tr: mātā pitaramṛta ā babhāja dhītyagre manasā saṃ hi jagme sā bībhatsurgarbharasā nividdhā namasvanta idupavākamīyuḥ
verses.en: The Mother gave the Sire his share of Order. With thought at first she wedded him in spirit. She, coyly loth, was filled with dew prolific. With adoration men approached to praise her.

verses.sa:
युक्ता मातासिद्धुरि दक्षिणाया अतिष्ठद् गर्भो वृजनीष्वन्तः ।
अमीमेद् वत्सो अनु गामपश्यद् विश्वरूप्यंऽ त्रिषु योजनेषु॥
verses.tr: yuktā mātāsiddhuri dakṣiṇāyā atiṣṭhad garbho vṛjanīṣvantaḥ amīmed vatso anu gāmapaśyad viśvarūpyaṃ' triṣu yojaneṣu
verses.en: Yoked was the Mother to the boon Cow's car-pole: in humid folds of cloud the infant rested. Then the Calf lowed and looked upon the Mother, the Cow who wears all shapes in three directions.

verses.sa:
तिस्रो मातॄस्त्रीन् पितॄन् बिभ्रदेक ऊर्ध्वस्तस्थौ नेमव ग्लापयन्त ।
मन्त्रयन्ते दिवो अमुष्य पृष्ठे विश्वविदो वाचमविश्वविन्नाम्॥
verses.tr: tisro mātṝstrīn pitṝn bibhradeka ūrdhvastasthau nemava glāpayanta mantrayante divo amuṣya pṛṣṭhe viśvavido vācamaviśvavinnām
verses.en: Bearing three mothers and three fathers, single he stood erect: they never made him weary. On yonder heaven's high ridge they speak together in speech not known to all, themselves all-knowing.

verses.sa:
पञ्चारे चक्रे परिवर्तमाने यस्मिन्नातस्थुर्भुवनानि विश्वा ।
तस्य नाक्षस्तप्यते भूरिभारः सनादेव न च्छिद्यते सनाभिः॥
verses.tr: pañcāre cakre parivartamāne yasminnātasthurbhuvanāni viśvā tasya nākṣastapyate bhūribhāraḥ sanādeva na cchidyate sanābhiḥ
verses.en: Upon the five-spoked wheel revolving ever, whereon all creatures rest and are dependent, The axle, heavy-laden, is not heated: the nave from ancient time remains unheated.

verses.sa:
पञ्चपादं पितरं द्वादशाकृतिं दिव आहुः परे अर्धे पुरीषिणम्।
अथेमे अन्य उपरे विचक्षणे सप्तचक्रे षडर आहुरर्पितम्॥
verses.tr: pañcapādaṃ pitaraṃ dvādaśākṛtiṃ diva āhuḥ pare ardhe purīṣiṇam atheme anya upare vicakṣaṇe saptacakre ṣaḍara āhurarpitam
verses.en: They call him in the farther half of heaven the Sire five-footed, of twelve forms, wealthy in watery store. These others, later still, say that he takes his stand upon a seven-wheeled car, six-spoked, whose sight is clear.

verses.sa:
द्वादशारं नहि तज्जराय वर्वर्ति चक्रं परि द्यामृतस्य ।
आ पुत्रा अग्ने मिथुनासो अत्र सप्त शतानि विंशतिश्च तस्थुः॥
verses.tr: dvādaśāraṃ nahi tajjarāya varvarti cakraṃ pari dyāmṛtasya ā putrā agne mithunāso atra sapta śatāni viṃśatiśca tasthuḥ
verses.en: Formed with twelve spokes, too strong for age to weaken, this wheel of during Order rolls round heaven. Herein established, joined in pairs together, seven hundred sons and twenty stand, O Agni.

verses.sa:
सनेमि चक्रमजरं वि वावृत उत्तानायां दश युक्ता वहन्ति ।
सूर्यस्य चक्षू रजसैत्यावृतं यस्मिन्नातस्थुर्भुवनानि विश्वा॥
verses.tr: sanemi cakramajaraṃ vi vāvṛta uttānāyāṃ daśa yuktā vahanti sūryasya cakṣū rajasaityāvṛtaṃ yasminnātasthurbhuvanāni viśvā
verses.en: The wheel revolves, unwasting, with its felly: ten draw it, yoked to the far-stretching car-pole. Girt by the region moves the eye of Surya, on whom dependent rest all living creatures.

verses.sa:
स्त्रियः सतीस्ताँ उ मे पुंसः आहुः पश्यदक्षण्वान् न वि चेतदन्धः ।
कविर्यः पुत्रः स ईमा चिकेत यस्ता विजानात् स पितुष्पितासत्॥
verses.tr: striyaḥ satīstāṃ u me puṃsaḥ āhuḥ paśyadakṣaṇvān na vi cetadandhaḥ kaviryaḥ putraḥ sa īmā ciketa yastā vijānāt sa pituṣpitāsat
verses.en: They told me these were males, though truly females. He who hath eyes sees this, the blind discerns not. The son who is a sage hath comprehended: who. knows this rightly is his father's father.

verses.sa:
साकंजानां सप्तथमाहुरेकजं षडिद् यमा ऋषयो देवजा इति ।
तेषामिष्टानि विहितानि धामश स्थात्रे रेजन्ते विकृतानि रूपशः॥
verses.tr: sākaṃjānāṃ saptathamāhurekajaṃ ṣaḍid yamā ṛṣayo devajā iti teṣāmiṣṭāni vihitāni dhāmaśa sthātre rejante vikṛtāni rūpaśaḥ
verses.en: Of the co-born they call the seventh single-born: the six twin pairs are called the Rishis, sons of Gods. Their good gifts sought of men are ranged in order due, and, various, form by form, move for their guiding Lord.

verses.sa:
अवः परेण पर एनावरेण पदा वत्सं बिभ्रती गौरुदस्थात्।
सा कद्रीची कं स्विदर्धं परागात् क्वऽस्वित्सूते नहि यूथे अस्मिन्॥
verses.tr: avaḥ pareṇa para enāvareṇa padā vatsaṃ bibhratī gaurudasthāt sā kadrīcī kaṃ svidardhaṃ parāgāt kva'svitsūte nahi yūthe asmin
verses.en: Beneath the upper realm, above this lower, bearing her Calf at foot, the Cow hath risen. Whitherward, to what place hath she departed? Where doth she calve? Not in this herd of cattle.

verses.sa:
अवः परेण पितरं यो अस्य वेदावः परेण पर एना वरेण ।
कवीयमानः क इह प्र वोचद् देवं मनः कुतो अधि प्रजातम्॥
verses.tr: avaḥ pareṇa pitaraṃ yo asya vedāvaḥ pareṇa para enā vareṇa kavīyamānaḥ ka iha pra vocad devaṃ manaḥ kuto adhi prajātam
verses.en: Who, that the father of this Calf discerneth beneath the upper realm, above the lower, Showing himself a sage, may here declare him? Whence hath the godlike spirit had its rising?

verses.sa:
ये अर्वाञ्चस्ताँ उ पराच आहुर्ये पराञ्चस्ताँ उ अर्वाच आहुः ।
इन्द्रश्च या चक्रथुः सोम तानि धुरा न युक्ता रजसो वहन्ति॥
verses.tr: ye arvāñcastāṃ u parāca āhurye parāñcastāṃ u arvāca āhuḥ indraśca yā cakrathuḥ soma tāni dhurā na yuktā rajaso vahanti
verses.en: Those that come hitherward they call departing, those that depart they call directed hither. Whatever ye have made, Indra and Soma! steeds draw, as 'twere, yoked to the region's car-pole.

verses.sa:
द्वा सुपर्णा सयुजा सखाया समानं वृक्षं परि षस्वजाते ।
तयोरन्यः पिप्पलं स्वाद्वत्त्यनश्नन्नन्यो अभि चाकशीति॥
verses.tr: dvā suparṇā sayujā sakhāyā samānaṃ vṛkṣaṃ pari ṣasvajāte tayoranyaḥ pippalaṃ svādvattyanaśnannanyo abhi cākaśīti
verses.en: Two Birds with fair wings, knit with bonds of friendship, in the same sheltering tree have found a refuge. One of the twain eats the sweet Fig-tree's berry: the other, eating not, regardeth only.

verses.sa:
यस्मिन् वृक्षे मध्वदः सुपर्णा निविशन्ते सुवते चाधि विश्वे ।
तस्य यदाहुः पिप्पलं स्वाद्वग्रे तन्नोन्नशद् यः पितरं न वेद॥
verses.tr: yasmin vṛkṣe madhvadaḥ suparṇā niviśante suvate cādhi viśve tasya yadāhuḥ pippalaṃ svādvagre tannonnaśad yaḥ pitaraṃ na veda
verses.en: The tree whereon the fine Birds eat the sweetness, where they all rest and procreate their offspring—Upon the top, they say, the fruit is luscious: none gaineth it who knoweth not the Father.

verses.sa:
यत्रा सुपर्णा अमृतस्य भक्षमनिमेषं विदथाभिस्वरन्ति ।
एना विश्वस्य भुवनस्य गोपाः स मा धीरः पाकमत्रा विवेश॥
verses.tr: yatrā suparṇā amṛtasya bhakṣamanimeṣaṃ vidathābhisvaranti enā viśvasya bhuvanasya gopāḥ sa mā dhīraḥ pākamatrā viveśa
verses.en: Where the fine birds hymn eeasfcleasly their portion of life eternal, and the sacred synods. There is the Universe's Guard and Keeper who, wise hath entered into me the simple.

verses.sa:
यद् गायत्रे अधि गायत्रमाहितं त्रैष्टुभं वा त्रैष्टुभान्निरतक्षत ।
यद् वा जगज्जगत्याहितं पदं य इत् तद् विदुस्ते अमृतत्वमानशुः॥
verses.tr: yad gāyatre adhi gāyatramāhitaṃ traiṣṭubhaṃ vā traiṣṭubhānniratakṣata yad vā jagajjagatyāhitaṃ padaṃ ya it tad viduste amṛtatvamānaśuḥ
verses.en: How on the Gayatri the Gayatri was based; how from the Trishtup they fashioned the Trishtup forth; How on the Jagati was based the Jagati—they who know this have won themselves immortal life.

verses.sa:
गायत्रेण प्रति मिमीते अर्कमर्केण साम त्रैष्टुभेन वाकम्।
वाकेन वाकं द्विपदा चतुष्पदाक्षरेण मिमते सप्त वाणीः॥
verses.tr: gāyatreṇa prati mimīte arkamarkeṇa sāma traiṣṭubhena vākam vākena vākaṃ dvipadā catuṣpadākṣareṇa mimate sapta vāṇīḥ
verses.en: With Gayatri he measures out the praise-song, Saman with praise-song, triplet with the Trishtup, The triplet with the two or four-foot measure, and with the syllable they form seven metres.

verses.sa:
जगता सिन्धुं दिव्यऽस्कभायद् रथंतरे सूर्यं पर्यपश्यत्।
गायत्रस्य समिधस्तिस्र आहुस्ततो मह्ना प्र रिरिचे महित्वा॥
verses.tr: jagatā sindhuṃ divya'skabhāyad rathaṃtare sūryaṃ paryapaśyat gāyatrasya samidhastisra āhustato mahnā pra ririce mahitvā
verses.en: With Jagati the flood in heaven he stablished, and saw the Sun in the Rathantara Saman. Gayatri hath, they say, three logs for burning: hence it excels in majesty and vigour.

verses.sa:
उप ह्वये सुदुघां धेनुमेतां सुहस्तो गोधुगुत दोहदेनाम्।
श्रेष्ठं सवं सविता साविषन्नोऽभीऽद्धो घर्मस्तदु षु प्र वोचत्॥
verses.tr: upa hvaye sudughāṃ dhenumetāṃ suhasto godhuguta dohadenām śreṣṭhaṃ savaṃ savitā sāviṣanno'bhī'ddho gharmastadu ṣu pra vocat
verses.en: I invocate this Milch-cow good at milking, so that the Milker, deft of hand, may milk her. May Savitar give goodliest stimulation. The caldron is made hot: he will proclaim it.

verses.sa:
हिङ्कृण्वती वसुपत्नी वसूनां वत्समिच्छन्ती मनसाभ्यागात्।
दुहामश्विभ्यां पयो अघ्न्येयं सा वर्धतां महते सौभगाय॥
verses.tr: hiṅkṛṇvatī vasupatnī vasūnāṃ vatsamicchantī manasābhyāgāt duhāmaśvibhyāṃ payo aghnyeyaṃ sā vardhatāṃ mahate saubhagāya
verses.en: She, Lady of all treasures, hath come hither, yearning in spirit for her calf, and lowing. May this Cow yield her milk for both the Asvins, and may she prosper to our high advantage,

verses.sa:
गौरमीमेदभि वत्सं मिषन्तं मूर्धानं हिङ्ङकृणोन्मातवा उ ।
सृक्वाणं घर्ममभि वावशाना मिमाति मायुं पयते पयोभिः॥
verses.tr: gauramīmedabhi vatsaṃ miṣantaṃ mūrdhānaṃ hiṅṅakṛṇonmātavā u sṛkvāṇaṃ gharmamabhi vāvaśānā mimāti māyuṃ payate payobhiḥ
verses.en: The Cow hath lowed after her blinking youngling: she licks his forehead as she lows, to form it. His mouth she fondly calls to her warm udder, and suckles him with milk while gently lowing.

verses.sa:
अयं स शिङ्क्ते येन गौरभिवृता मिमाति मायुं ध्वसनावधि श्रिता।
सा चित्तिभिर्नि हि चकार मर्त्यान् विद्युद् भवन्ती प्रति वव्रिमौहत॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ sa śiṅkte yena gaurabhivṛtā mimāti māyuṃ dhvasanāvadhi śritā sā cittibhirni hi cakāra martyān vidyud bhavantī prati vavrimauhata
verses.en: He also snorts, by whom encompassed round the Cow lows as she closely clings to him who sheds the rain. She with her shrilling cries hath humbled mortal men, and, turned to lightning, hath stripped off her covering robe.

verses.sa:
अनच्छये तुरगातु जीवमेजद् ध्रुवं मध्य आ पस्त्याऽनाम्।
जीवो मृतस्य चरति स्वधाभिरमर्त्यो मर्त्येना सयोनिः॥
verses.tr: anacchaye turagātu jīvamejad dhruvaṃ madhya ā pastyā'nām jīvo mṛtasya carati svadhābhiramartyo martyenā sayoniḥ
verses.en: That which hath breath and life and speed and motion lies firmly stablished in the midst of houses. The living moves by powers of the departed: the immortal is the brother of the mortal.

verses.sa:
विधुं दद्राणं सलिलस्य पृष्ठे युवानं सन्तं पलितो जगार ।
देवस्य पश्य काव्यं महित्वाद्य ममार स ह्यः समान॥
verses.tr: vidhuṃ dadrāṇaṃ salilasya pṛṣṭhe yuvānaṃ santaṃ palito jagāra devasya paśya kāvyaṃ mahitvādya mamāra sa hyaḥ samāna
verses.en: The old hath waked the young Moon from his slumber, who runs his circling course with many round him. Behold the God's high wisdom in its greatness: he who died yesterday to-day is living.

verses.sa:
य ईं चकार न सो अस्य वेद य ईं ददर्श हिरुगिन्नु तस्मात्।
स मातुर्योना परिवीतो अन्तर्बहुप्रजा निरृतिरा विवेश॥
verses.tr: ya īṃ cakāra na so asya veda ya īṃ dadarśa hiruginnu tasmāt sa māturyonā parivīto antarbahuprajā nirṛtirā viveśa
verses.en: He who hath made him doth not comprehend him: from him who saw him surely he is hidden. He, yet enveloped in his mother's bosom, source of much life, hath sunk into destruction.

verses.sa:
अपश्यं गोपामनिपद्यमानमा च परा च पथिभिश्चरन्तम्।
ससध्रीचीः स विषूचीर्वसान आ वरीवर्ति भुवनेष्वन्तः॥
verses.tr: apaśyaṃ gopāmanipadyamānamā ca parā ca pathibhiścarantam sasadhrīcīḥ sa viṣūcīrvasāna ā varīvarti bhuvaneṣvantaḥ
verses.en: I saw the Herdsman, him who never stumbles, approaching by his pathways and departing. He, clothed with gathered and diffusive splendours, within the worlds continually travels.

verses.sa:
द्यौर्नः पिता जनिता नाभिरत्र बन्धुर्नो माता पृथिवी महीयम्।
उत्तानयोश्चम्वो३र्योनिरन्तरत्रा पिता दुहितुर्गर्भमाधात्॥
verses.tr: dyaurnaḥ pitā janitā nābhiratra bandhurno mātā pṛthivī mahīyam uttānayoścamvo3ryonirantaratrā pitā duhiturgarbhamādhāt
verses.en: Dyaus is our father, our begetter: kinship is here. This great Earth is our kin and mother. Between the wide-spread world-halves is the birthplace. The Father laid the Daughter's germ within it.

verses.sa:
पृच्छामि त्वा परमन्तं पृथिव्याः पृच्छामि वृष्णो अश्वस्य रेतः ।
पृच्छामि विश्वस्य भुवनस्य नाभिं पृच्छामि वाचः परमं व्योऽम॥
verses.tr: pṛcchāmi tvā paramantaṃ pṛthivyāḥ pṛcchāmi vṛṣṇo aśvasya retaḥ pṛcchāmi viśvasya bhuvanasya nābhiṃ pṛcchāmi vācaḥ paramaṃ vyo'ma
verses.en: I bid thee tell me earth's extremest limit, about the Stallion's genial flow I ask thee; I ask about the universe's centre, and touching highest heaven where Speech abideth.

verses.sa:
इयं वेदिः परो अन्तः पृथिव्या अयं सोमो वृष्णो अश्वस्य रेतः ।
अयं यज्ञो विश्वस्य भुवनस्य नाभिर्ब्रह्मायं वाचः परमं व्योऽम॥
verses.tr: iyaṃ vediḥ paro antaḥ pṛthivyā ayaṃ somo vṛṣṇo aśvasya retaḥ ayaṃ yajño viśvasya bhuvanasya nābhirbrahmāyaṃ vācaḥ paramaṃ vyo'ma
verses.en: The earth's most distant limit is this altar: this Soma is the Stallion's genial humour; This sacrifice the universe's centre: this Brahman highest heaven where Speech abideth.

verses.sa:
न वि जानामि यदिवेदमस्मि निण्यः संनद्धो मनसा चरामि ।
यदा मागन् प्रथमजा ऋतस्यादिद् वाचो अश्नुवे भागमस्याः॥
verses.tr: na vi jānāmi yadivedamasmi niṇyaḥ saṃnaddho manasā carāmi yadā māgan prathamajā ṛtasyādid vāco aśnuve bhāgamasyāḥ
verses.en: What thing I truly am I know not clearly: mysterious, fettered in my mind I wander. When the first-born of holy Law approached me, then of this Speech I first obtain a portion.

verses.sa:
अपाङ् प्राङेति स्वधया गृभीतोऽमर्त्यो मर्त्येना सयोनिः ।
ता शश्वन्ता विषूचीना वियन्ता न्य१न्यं चिक्युर्न नि चिक्युरन्यम्॥
verses.tr: apāṅ prāṅeti svadhayā gṛbhīto'martyo martyenā sayoniḥ tā śaśvantā viṣūcīnā viyantā nya1nyaṃ cikyurna ni cikyuranyam
verses.en: Back, forward goes he, grasped by power inherent, immortal born the brother of the mortal. Ceaseless they move in opposite directions: men mark the one and fail to mark the other.

verses.sa:
सप्तार्धगर्भा भुवनस्य रेतो विष्णोस्तिष्ठन्ति प्रदिशा विधर्मणि ।
ते धीतिभिर्मनसा ते विपश्चितः परिभुवः परि भवन्ति विश्वतः॥
verses.tr: saptārdhagarbhā bhuvanasya reto viṣṇostiṣṭhanti pradiśā vidharmaṇi te dhītibhirmanasā te vipaścitaḥ paribhuvaḥ pari bhavanti viśvataḥ
verses.en: Seven germs unripened yet are Heaven's prolific seed: their functions they maintain by Vishnu's ordinance. Endued with wisdom through intelligence and thought, present on every side they compass us about.

verses.sa:
ऋचो अक्षरे परमे व्योऽमन् यस्मिन् देवा अधि विश्वे निषेदुः ।
यस्तन्न वेद किमृचा करिष्यति य इत् तद् विदुस्ते अमी समासते॥
verses.tr: ṛco akṣare parame vyo'man yasmin devā adhi viśve niṣeduḥ yastanna veda kimṛcā kariṣyati ya it tad viduste amī samāsate
verses.en: Upon what syllable of holy praise-hymn, as 'twere their highest heaven, the Gods repose them—Who knows not this, what will he do. with praise-hymn? But they who know it well sit here assembled.

verses.sa:
ऋचः पदं मात्रया कल्पयन्तोऽर्धर्चेन चाक्लृपुर्विश्वमेजत्।
त्रिपाद् ब्रह्म पुरुरूपं वि तष्ठे तेन जीवन्ति प्रदिशश्चतस्रः॥
verses.tr: ṛcaḥ padaṃ mātrayā kalpayanto'rdharcena cāklṛpurviśvamejat tripād brahma pururūpaṃ vi taṣṭhe tena jīvanti pradiśaścatasraḥ
verses.en: They, ordering the verse's foot by measure, with the half-verse arranged each thing that moveth. Prayer was diffused in many forms three-footed: thereby the world's four regions have their being.

verses.sa:
सूयवसाद् भगवती हि भूया अधा वयं भगवन्तः स्याम ।
अद्धि तृणमघ्न्ये विश्वदानीं पिब शुद्धमुदकमाचरन्ती॥
verses.tr: sūyavasād bhagavatī hi bhūyā adhā vayaṃ bhagavantaḥ syāma addhi tṛṇamaghnye viśvadānīṃ piba śuddhamudakamācarantī
verses.en: Fortunate mayst thou be with goodly pasture, and may we also be exceeding wealthy. Feed on the grass, O Cow, through all the seasons, and coming hitherward drink limpid water.

verses.sa:
गौरिन्मिमाय सलिलानि तक्षत्येकपदी द्विपदी सा चतुष्पदी ।
अष्टापदी नवपदी बभूवुषी सहस्राक्षरा भुवनस्य पङ्क्तिस्तस्याः समुद्रा अधि वि क्षरन्ति॥
verses.tr: gaurinmimāya salilāni takṣatyekapadī dvipadī sā catuṣpadī aṣṭāpadī navapadī babhūvuṣī sahasrākṣarā bhuvanasya paṅktistasyāḥ samudrā adhi vi kṣaranti
verses.en: Forming the water-floods the Cow herself hath lowed, one-footed or two-footed or four-footed, she, Who hath become eight-footed or acquired nine feet, the universe's thousand-syllabled Pankti. From her descend in streams the seas of water.

verses.sa:
कृष्णं नियानं हरयः सुपर्णा अपो वसाना दिवमुत्पतन्ति ।
तं आववृत्रन्त्सदनादृतस्यादिद् घृतेन पृथिवीं व्यूऽदुः॥
verses.tr: kṛṣṇaṃ niyānaṃ harayaḥ suparṇā apo vasānā divamutpatanti taṃ āvavṛtrantsadanādṛtasyādid ghṛtena pṛthivīṃ vyū'duḥ
verses.en: Dark the descent: the birds are golden-coloured. Robed in the floods they fly aloft to heaven. Again from Order's seat have they descended, and inundated all the earth with fatness.

verses.sa:
अपादेति प्रथमा पद्वतीनां कस्तद् वां मित्रावरुणा चिकेत ।
गर्भो भारं भरत्या चिदस्या ऋतं पिपर्त्यनृतं नि पाति॥
verses.tr: apādeti prathamā padvatīnāṃ kastad vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā ciketa garbho bhāraṃ bharatyā cidasyā ṛtaṃ pipartyanṛtaṃ ni pāti
verses.en: The footless Maid precedeth footed creatures. Who marketh, Mitra Varuna! this your doing? The Babe unborn supporteth this world's burthen, 'supporteth Right and watcheth Wrong and Falsehood.

verses.sa:
विराड् वाग् विराट् पृथिवी विराडन्तरिक्षं विराट् प्रजापतिः ।
विराण्मृत्युः साध्यानामधिराजो बभूव तस्य भूतं भव्यं वशे स मे भूतं भव्यं वशे कृणोतु॥
verses.tr: virāḍ vāg virāṭ pṛthivī virāḍantarikṣaṃ virāṭ prajāpatiḥ virāṇmṛtyuḥ sādhyānāmadhirājo babhūva tasya bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ vaśe sa me bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ vaśe kṛṇotu
verses.en: Viraj is Speech, and Earth, and Air's mid-region. He is Prajapati, and he is Mrityu. He is the Lord Imperial of the Sadhyas. He rules what is and what shall be hereafter. May he make me lord of what is and shall be.

verses.sa:
शकमयं धूममारादपश्यं विषूवता पर एनावरेण ।
उक्षाणं पृश्निमपचन्त वीरास्तानि धर्माणि प्रथमान्यासन्॥
verses.tr: śakamayaṃ dhūmamārādapaśyaṃ viṣūvatā para enāvareṇa ukṣāṇaṃ pṛśnimapacanta vīrāstāni dharmāṇi prathamānyāsan
verses.en: I saw from far away the smoke of fuel with spires that rose on high o'er that beneath it. The heroes cooked and dressed the spotted bullock. These were the customs in the days aforetime.

verses.sa:
त्रयः केशिन ऋतुथा वि चक्षते संवत्सरे वपत एक एषाम्।
विश्वमन्यो अभिचष्टे शचीभिर्ध्राजिरेकस्य ददृशे न रूपम्॥
verses.tr: trayaḥ keśina ṛtuthā vi cakṣate saṃvatsare vapata eka eṣām viśvamanyo abhicaṣṭe śacībhirdhrājirekasya dadṛśe na rūpam
verses.en: Three with long tresses show in ordered season. One of them sheareth when the year is ended. One with his powers the universe regardeth. Of one the sweep is seen, but not the figure.

verses.sa:
चत्वारि वाक् परिमिता पदानि तानि विदुर्ब्राह्मणा ये मनीषिणः ।
गुहा त्रीणि निहिता नेङ्गयन्ति तुरीयं वाचो मनुष्याऽवदन्ति॥
verses.tr: catvāri vāk parimitā padāni tāni vidurbrāhmaṇā ye manīṣiṇaḥ guhā trīṇi nihitā neṅgayanti turīyaṃ vāco manuṣyā'vadanti
verses.en: Speech hath been measured out in four divisions: the Brahmans who have wisdom comprehend them. Three, kept in close concealment, cause no motion. Of Speech men speak the fourth division only.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रं मित्रं वरुणमग्निमाहुरथो दिव्यः स सुपर्णो गरुत्मान्।
एकं सद् विप्रा बहुधा वदन्त्यग्निं यमं मातरिश्वानमाहुः॥
verses.tr: indraṃ mitraṃ varuṇamagnimāhuratho divyaḥ sa suparṇo garutmān ekaṃ sad viprā bahudhā vadantyagniṃ yamaṃ mātariśvānamāhuḥ
verses.en: They call him Indra, Mitra, Varuna, Agni; and he is heavenly nobly-winged Garutman. That which is One bards call by many a title: they call It Agni, Yama, Matarisvan.
